Figure 1c
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)

# ── Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
base_dir <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

gene_disease_matrix <- readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "gene_disease_matrix.rds"))
metadata            <- read.csv(file.path(base_dir, "DzSignatures2.4.2026/sig_meta_final.csv"))

out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures/FigureFinal")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ── Configuration ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TISSUES      <- c("Brain", "Liver", "Kidney", "Lung", "Heart")  # one column each
GENE         <- "GLP1R"
FC_THRESHOLD <- 1     # significance reference only; no longer a hard cutoff (see cell_df)
CAP          <- 5
N_PER_TISSUE <- 5     # how many top-|log2FC| diseases to show per tissue column

# Diseases to drop from specific tissue columns before ranking (metastatic /
# secondary-site entries that read confusingly next to that tissue's primary
# disease burden). Matched as a case-insensitive substring against the Disease
# name, so e.g. "medulloblastoma" also catches "Metastatic medulloblastoma".
# Excluded diseases are dropped BEFORE head(N_PER_TISSUE), so the remaining
# slots backfill with the next-highest |log2FC| disease for that tissue -
# each column still shows N_PER_TISSUE rows.
EXCLUDE_BY_TISSUE <- list(
  Heart = c("medulloblastoma"),
  Liver = c("prostatic neoplasms", "stomach neoplasms", "colorectal neoplasms"),
  Lung  = c("prostatic neoplasms", "laryngeal neoplasms", "breast neoplasms")
  
)

# ---- Appearance ----
FS_ROW    <- 11       # disease label font size (was 8)
FS_COL    <- 14       # tissue title font size (was 11)
FS_LEGEND <- 11       # legend title / labels
CELL_W_CM <- 1.7      # fixed cell width  (every column identical)
CELL_H_CM <- 2.0      # fixed cell height (every row identical)
LBL_W_CM  <- 3.6      # reserved width for row labels (wrapped labels still fit;
                      # trimmed from 4.2 so the body isn't pushed so far right
                      # that the centered tissue title overflows the grob edge)

# ── Organ harmonization ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
harmonize_organ <- function(x) {
  x_chr   <- as.character(x)
  x_clean <- str_trim(x_chr)
  x_clean <- str_replace_all(x_clean, "\\s+", "_")
  x_key   <- str_to_lower(x_clean)
  case_when(
    is.na(x_chr) | x_key %in% c("", "na", "n/a", "ua", "unknown") ~ "Unknown",
    x_key == "adrenal_gland" ~ "Adrenal_gland",
    x_key %in% c("lymphatic_tissue", "lymphoid_tissue") ~ "Lymphoid_tissue",
    x_key == "head_and_neck" ~ "Head_and_neck",
    x_key == "lining_of_body_cavities" ~ "Lining_of_body_cavities",
    TRUE ~ str_to_sentence(x_key)
  )
}

metadata <- metadata %>% mutate(OrganRegion = harmonize_organ(OrganRegion))

# ── Long-form GLP1R values per (disease, tissue) ────────────────────────────────
df <- gene_disease_matrix %>% filter(gene_name %in% GENE)

disease_annotation <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::select(Disease, OrganRegion) %>%
  mutate(OrganRegion = harmonize_organ(OrganRegion)) %>%
  distinct()

cell_df <- df %>%
  dplyr::select(identifier, gene_name, where(is.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(identifier, gene_name), names_to = "Disease", values_to = "log2FoldChange") %>%
  left_join(disease_annotation, by = "Disease", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(log2FoldChange = pmax(pmin(log2FoldChange, CAP), -CAP)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%        # keep ALL measured values (sig + non-sig)
  filter(OrganRegion %in% TISSUES) %>%
  group_by(Disease, OrganRegion) %>%
  summarise(log2FoldChange = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
# NOTE: the FC_THRESHOLD filter is intentionally dropped here. Selection below
# ranks by |log2FC| descending, so the largest (significant) effects still land
# at the top of each column and the remaining slots fill with the next-largest
# (possibly sub-threshold) diseases instead of grey blanks.

# ── Shared colour scale (so all five columns are comparable) ────────────────────
col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(c(-CAP, 0, CAP), c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))

# ── Baseline GLP1R expression per tissue (absolute, from ARCHS4 controls) ───────
# This is a DIFFERENT quantity from the disease log2FC cells, so it gets its own
# blue->red scale: blue = low/zero expression, red = high. We read the per-tissue
# summary the query script wrote and use mean_log2cpm (log2(CPM+1)).
expr_path <- file.path(base_dir, "ARCHS4/GLP1R_baseline_expression_by_tissue.csv")
expr_tbl  <- read.csv(expr_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# named vector: tissue -> mean log2(CPM+1)
expr_vec <- setNames(expr_tbl$mean_log2cpm, expr_tbl$tissue)[TISSUES]

# expression scale runs 0 (blue) -> max observed (red). 0 anchors "no expression"
# at the blue end as requested; midpoint is light for readability.
expr_max <- max(expr_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
expr_col_fun <- circlize::colorRamp2(
  c(0, expr_max / 2, expr_max),
  c("#2166AC", "#F7F7F7", "#B2182B")   # blue -> light -> red
)

# Break disease names so they stay narrow in the label column:
#   1. newline at every hyphen (as before), then
#   2. wrap any remaining single word longer than WRAP_CHARS by inserting a
#      hyphen + newline, so long unbroken names like "Oligodendroastrocytoma"
#      don't run off the left edge.
# IMPORTANT: returns exactly ONE string per input name (newlines embedded), so
# the label vector length always matches the matrix.
WRAP_CHARS <- 14
wrap_one <- function(s) {
  tokens <- strsplit(s, "-", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  pieces <- unlist(lapply(tokens, function(tok) {
    if (nchar(tok) <= WRAP_CHARS) return(tok)
    starts <- seq(1, nchar(tok), by = WRAP_CHARS)
    chunk  <- substring(tok, starts, pmin(starts + WRAP_CHARS - 1, nchar(tok)))
    # trailing hyphen on all but the last chunk of one long word
    paste0(chunk, c(rep("-", length(chunk) - 1), ""))
  }))
  paste(pieces, collapse = "\n")
}
# vectorized wrapper: one output string per input element
wrap_hyphen <- function(x) vapply(x, wrap_one, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

# ── Build one tissue column: expression box on top, gap, then disease cells ─────
# Each column is independent: its own diseases (top N by |log2FC| in that tissue),
# its own row labels, ranked strongest-first from the top. Every disease block is
# padded to exactly N_PER_TISSUE rows (extra rows are grey blanks) and uses
# identical fixed cell dimensions, so all five columns are the same size.
#
# The baseline-expression box is a separate one-row Heatmap on its own scale,
# vertically stacked above the disease heatmap via %v% with a spacer so it reads
# as a distinct band.
make_tissue_column <- function(tissue, show_disease_legend, show_expr_legend, is_first_col) {
  # --- disease block ---
  exclude_pat <- EXCLUDE_BY_TISSUE[[tissue]]

  d <- cell_df %>%
    filter(OrganRegion == tissue)

  if (!is.null(exclude_pat)) {
    # multi-word patterns are written with plain spaces above, but the actual
    # Disease strings may use spaces, underscores, or dots between words
    # (depends on how the source matrix's column names were sanitized) - so
    # treat any of those as equivalent when matching.
    drop_hit <- Reduce(`|`, lapply(exclude_pat, function(p) {
      p_rx <- str_replace_all(p, " ", "[ _.-]+")
      str_detect(d$Disease, regex(p_rx, ignore_case = TRUE))
    }))
    d <- d[!drop_hit, ]
  }

  d <- d %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange))) %>%
    head(N_PER_TISSUE)

  vals <- d$log2FoldChange
  labs <- wrap_hyphen(d$Disease)

  n_pad <- N_PER_TISSUE - length(vals)
  if (n_pad > 0) {
    vals <- c(vals, rep(NA_real_, n_pad))
    labs <- c(labs, strrep(" ", seq_len(n_pad)))
  }

  m <- matrix(vals, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(labs, tissue))

  ht_disease <- Heatmap(
    m, name = paste0("log2fc_", tissue),
    col          = col_fun,
    na_col       = "grey80",
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names    = TRUE, row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = FS_ROW),
    row_names_max_width = unit(LBL_W_CM, "cm"),
    show_column_names = FALSE,
    rect_gp           = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
    width             = unit(CELL_W_CM, "cm"),
    height            = unit(CELL_H_CM * N_PER_TISSUE, "cm"),
    show_heatmap_legend = show_disease_legend,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "GLP1R\nlog2FC",
      title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = FS_LEGEND, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_LEGEND)
    )
  )

  # --- baseline expression box (one row, own scale) ---
  ev <- expr_vec[[tissue]]
  # only the first column shows the "Baseline expression" left-label; blank
  # (unique whitespace) elsewhere so it isn't restated five times.
  expr_row_label <- if (is_first_col) "Baseline\nexpression" else " "
  em <- matrix(ev, nrow = 1, ncol = 1,
               dimnames = list(expr_row_label, tissue))

  ht_expr <- Heatmap(
    em, name = paste0("log2cpm_", tissue),
    col          = expr_col_fun,
    na_col       = "grey80",
    cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names    = TRUE, row_names_side = "left",
    row_names_gp      = gpar(fontsize = FS_ROW, fontface = "italic"),
    row_names_max_width = unit(LBL_W_CM, "cm"),
    show_column_names = FALSE,                    # title via column_title (no clip)
    column_title      = tissue,
    column_title_side = "top",
    column_title_gp   = gpar(fontsize = FS_COL, fontface = "bold"),
    rect_gp           = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 1),
    width             = unit(CELL_W_CM, "cm"),
    height            = unit(CELL_H_CM, "cm"),
    show_heatmap_legend = show_expr_legend,
    heatmap_legend_param = list(
      title = "GLP1R\nlog2(CPM+1)",
      title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = FS_LEGEND, fontface = "bold"),
      labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_LEGEND)
    )
  )

  # stack: expression box on TOP of the disease block, with a visible gap
  ht_list <- ht_expr %v% ht_disease
  ht_list
}

# capture each column as a grob. The disease legend rides on the last column;
# the expression legend rides on the first, so both scales are shown once.
col_grobs <- lapply(seq_along(TISSUES), function(i) {
  is_last  <- (i == length(TISSUES))
  is_first <- (i == 1)
  # both legends ride on the LAST column so they stack together on the far
  # right, clear of the data (rather than wedged between columns).
  ht <- make_tissue_column(
    TISSUES[i],
    show_disease_legend = is_last,
    show_expr_legend    = is_last,
    is_first_col        = is_first
  )
  # The centered tissue title overflows to the RIGHT of the heatmap body. When a
  # column has a long left-hand disease label (e.g. "Oligodendroastrocytoma"),
  # the body is pushed right inside the grob and the title's right overflow gets
  # clipped at the grob edge. Generous right padding on EVERY column gives the
  # centered title room to overflow into. The last column needs still more for
  # the two stacked legends.
  right_pad <- if (is_last) 48 else 30
  grid.grabExpr(draw(
    ht,
    heatmap_legend_side = "right",
    ht_gap = unit(6, "mm"),
    padding = unit(c(4, 12, 4, right_pad), "mm")    # b, l, t, r
  ))
})

# ── Arrange the five columns side by side + render ──────────────────────────────
# Give the legend-bearing last column a wider relative slot so it doesn't steal
# width from (or compress) the other four equal columns.
col_widths <- unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1.5), "null")
arranged <- arrangeGrob(grobs = col_grobs, ncol = length(TISSUES),
                        widths = col_widths)

png(file.path(out_dir, "Figure1c.png"), width = 8100, height = 4800, res = 600)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(arranged)
dev.off()

cat("Saved:", file.path(out_dir, "Figure1c.png"), "\n")

# ── Preview in the RStudio plot pane ────────────────────────────────────────────
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(arranged)
```

```{r}
 ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Figure 2A — Hallmark GSEA Heatmap (publication-ready)
# Text scaled ~1.5x; heatmap cells fixed at ~0.5x to preserve overall figure size
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
})

# ---- Global sans-serif font ----
SANS <- "Helvetica"   # or "Arial"; on Linux use "sans". Embedded below via pdf().

# ---- Cell dimensions (shrunk so larger text fits the same canvas) ----
CELL_W <- unit(5, "mm")
CELL_H <- unit(5, "mm")

# ==============================================================================
# 1. PATHS
# ==============================================================================
base_dir   <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(base_dir, "Human_Hallmark_GSEA")
FIG_DIR    <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures")
META_FILE  <- file.path(base_dir, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LOAD GSEA RESULTS
# ==============================================================================
gsea_files <- list.files(OUTPUT_DIR, pattern = "_GSEA_Hallmark_results.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
gsea_files <- gsea_files[grepl("^(GSE|Chen)", basename(gsea_files))]
gsea_files <- gsea_files[grepl("_S_", basename(gsea_files))]


message(sprintf("Found %d individual signature GSEA files (_S_ only).", length(gsea_files)))

all_gsea <- map_dfr(gsea_files, function(f) {
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj) %>%
    mutate(
      NES    = as.numeric(NES),
      padj   = as.numeric(padj),
      Sample = str_remove(basename(f), "_GSEA_Hallmark_results.csv")
    )
})

# ==============================================================================
# 3. BUILD NES MATRIX
# ==============================================================================
nes_mat <- all_gsea %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, Sample, NES) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = NES, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pathway") %>%
  as.matrix()

padj_mat <- all_gsea %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, Sample, padj) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = padj, values_fill = 1) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pathway") %>%
  as.matrix()

nes_mat  <- nes_mat[sort(rownames(nes_mat)),  sort(colnames(nes_mat))]
padj_mat <- padj_mat[sort(rownames(padj_mat)), sort(colnames(padj_mat))]

message(sprintf("Matrix: %d pathways x %d samples", nrow(nes_mat), ncol(nes_mat)))

# ---- Prettify pathway names ----
pretty_pathway <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
    str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    str_to_title() %>%
    str_replace_all(c(
      "Nfkb" = "NF-\u03baB", "Tnfa" = "TNFA", "Il2" = "IL2", "Il6" = "IL6",
      "Stat5" = "STAT5", "Stat3" = "STAT3", "Jak" = "JAK", "Kras" = "KRAS",
      "Mtorc1" = "mTORC1", "Pi3k" = "PI3K", "Akt" = "AKT", "Mtor" = "mTOR",
      "P53" = "P53", "Tgf" = "TGF", "Uv" = "UV", "E2f" = "E2F", "G2m" = "G2M",
      "Dna" = "DNA", "Myc" = "MYC", "Wnt" = "WNT", "Egf" = "EGF"
    ))
}
rownames(nes_mat)  <- pretty_pathway(rownames(nes_mat))
rownames(padj_mat) <- rownames(nes_mat)

# ==============================================================================
# 4. COLUMN ANNOTATIONS
# ==============================================================================
parse_sample_meta <- function(sample_names) {
  species <- case_when(
    grepl("_Mouse_|^Mouse_", sample_names) ~ "Mouse",
    grepl("_Rat_|^Rat_",     sample_names) ~ "Rat",
    grepl("^All_|^Mouse_All|^Rat_All", sample_names) ~ "Meta",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  tissue <- case_when(
    grepl("Liver",    sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Liver",
    grepl("Brain",    sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Brain",
    grepl("Heart",    sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Heart",
    grepl("Kidney",   sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Kidney",
    grepl("Lung",     sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Lung",
    grepl("Adipose|Adipos|WAT", sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Adipose",
    grepl("Pancreas|pancreas",  sample_names, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Pancreas",
    grepl("^All_|^Mouse_All|^Rat_All|SansPancreas", sample_names) ~ "Meta",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
  data.frame(species = species, tissue = tissue, row.names = sample_names)
}

col_meta <- parse_sample_meta(colnames(nes_mat))

species_cols <- c(Mouse = "#4393C3", Rat = "#D6604D", Meta = "#878787", Other = "#CCCCCC")
tissue_cols  <- c(
  Liver   = "#E6842A", Brain  = "#6A51A3", Heart  = "#D6604D",
  Kidney  = "#35978F", Lung   = "#74C476", Adipose = "#FDD0A2",
  Pancreas = "#BCBDDC", Meta  = "#878787", Other  = "#CCCCCC"
)

tissue_order <- c("Liver", "Brain", "Heart", "Kidney", "Lung",
                  "Adipose", "Pancreas", "Meta", "Other")
tissue_order <- tissue_order[tissue_order %in% unique(col_meta$tissue)]
col_split <- factor(col_meta$tissue, levels = tissue_order)

make_col_ann <- function(meta) {
  HeatmapAnnotation(
    Species = meta$species,
    Tissue  = meta$tissue,
    col = list(
      Species = species_cols[names(species_cols) %in% unique(meta$species)],
      Tissue  = tissue_cols[ names(tissue_cols)  %in% unique(meta$tissue)]
    ),
    annotation_name_gp   = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontfamily = SANS),
    annotation_legend_param = list(
      Species = list(title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = SANS),
                     labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontfamily = SANS)),
      Tissue  = list(title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = SANS),
                     labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontfamily = SANS))
    ),
    simple_anno_size = unit(6, "mm"),
    gap = unit(1, "mm")
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 5. COLOR SCALE
# ==============================================================================
limit   <- max(abs(nes_mat), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-limit, 0, limit), c("#08306B", "white", "#A50F15"))

legend_param <- list(
  title         = "NES",
  title_gp      = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = SANS),
  labels_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontfamily = SANS),
  legend_height = unit(4.5, "cm"),
  grid_width    = unit(0.7, "cm")
)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. HEATMAP BUILDER
# ==============================================================================
build_ht <- function(mat_display, mat_cluster, col_ann,
                     col_split = NULL, title = "", na_col = "grey90") {
  Heatmap(
    mat_display,
    name   = "NES",
    col    = col_fun,
    na_col = na_col,
    # --- fixed cell size: shrinks the body so bigger text fits the same page ---
    width  = ncol(mat_display) * CELL_W,
    height = nrow(mat_display) * CELL_H,
    # --- 1.5x text ---
    row_names_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 12,   fontfamily = SANS),
    column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10.5, fontfamily = SANS),
    column_names_rot      = -45,
    column_names_side     = "bottom",
    column_names_centered = FALSE,
    column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 21, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = SANS),
    row_title_gp    = gpar(fontsize = 18, fontfamily = SANS),
    column_title = title,
    top_annotation = col_ann,
    column_split   = col_split,
    cluster_rows             = TRUE,
    cluster_columns          = TRUE,
    show_row_dend            = FALSE,
    show_column_dend         = FALSE,
    clustering_distance_rows = function(m) dist(mat_cluster),
    heatmap_legend_param = legend_param,
    border = TRUE
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 7. SHARED FILE SAVER  (PDF + PNG)
# ==============================================================================
draw_to_file <- function(ht, base_path, w, h) {

  # PDF
  pdf(paste0(base_path, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = SANS)
  draw(
    ht,
    padding                = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"),
    merge_legend           = TRUE,
    heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
    annotation_legend_side = "right"
  )
  dev.off()
  message(sprintf("Saved: %s.pdf", basename(base_path)))

  # PNG
  png(paste0(base_path, ".png"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = 300)
  draw(
    ht,
    padding                = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 4), "mm"),
    merge_legend           = TRUE,
    heatmap_legend_side    = "right",
    annotation_legend_side = "right"
  )
  dev.off()
  message(sprintf("Saved: %s.png", basename(base_path)))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 8. DRAW — ALL SIGNATURES
# ==============================================================================
ht_all <- build_ht(
  nes_mat, nes_mat, make_col_ann(col_meta),
  col_split = col_split,
  title     = "GSEA NES: All Signatures"
)
draw_to_file(ht_all, file.path(FIG_DIR, "Figure2A_Heatmap_All"), w = 13, h = 14)

# ==============================================================================
# 9. DRAW — SIGNIFICANT ONLY
# ==============================================================================
nes_sig <- nes_mat
nes_sig[padj_mat > 0.05] <- NA
keep_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(nes_sig)) > 0
keep_cols <- colSums(!is.na(nes_sig)) > 0

if (sum(keep_rows) > 1 && sum(keep_cols) > 1) {
  nes_sig_sub  <- nes_sig[keep_rows, keep_cols]
  nes_cln_sub  <- nes_mat[keep_rows, keep_cols]
  col_meta_sub <- col_meta[colnames(nes_sig_sub), , drop = FALSE]

  col_split_sub <- factor(col_meta_sub$tissue, levels = tissue_order)

  ht_sig <- build_ht(
    nes_sig_sub, nes_cln_sub, make_col_ann(col_meta_sub),
    col_split = col_split_sub,
    title     = "Significant GSEA (FDR < 0.05): All Signatures",
    na_col    = "grey90"
  )
  draw_to_file(ht_sig, file.path(FIG_DIR, "Figure2A_Heatmap_Sig"), w = 13, h = 14)
}

message("Done.")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Reactome & GOBP Stability Analysis — Dual Lollipop Plots
# Large text throughout; pathway labels wrapped to keep panels in place
# ==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(patchwork)

# ==============================================================================
# 0. PATHS
# ==============================================================================
BASE_DIR <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"
GSEA_DIR      <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "ReactomeGOBPgsea")
METADATA_PATH <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")
OUTPUT_DIR    <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Figures/Supplement")

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD METADATA & DEFINE COHORTS
# ==============================================================================
message("Loading Metadata...")
study_list <- read_excel(METADATA_PATH) %>%
  mutate(
    Is_Pancreas    = grepl("Pancreas", tissue, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Is_Chen        = grepl("Chen", Signature_source, ignore.case = TRUE) | grepl("Chen", Key, ignore.case = TRUE),
    Tissue_Grouped = case_when(
      grepl("Liver", tissue, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Liver",
      grepl("Brain", tissue, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Brain",
      TRUE ~ tissue
    )
  )

cohorts <- list()
cohorts[["All_SansPancreas"]] <- study_list %>% filter(!Is_Pancreas) %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["Mouse_All"]]        <- study_list %>% filter(species == "Mouse", !Is_Pancreas) %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["Mouse_Liver"]]      <- study_list %>% filter(species == "Mouse", grepl("Liver", Tissue_Grouped, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["All_Liver"]]        <- study_list %>% filter(grepl("Liver", Tissue_Grouped, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["Mouse_Brain"]]      <- study_list %>% filter(species == "Mouse", Tissue_Grouped == "Brain") %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["All_Brain"]]        <- study_list %>% filter(Tissue_Grouped == "Brain") %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["Rat_All"]]          <- study_list %>% filter(species == "Rat") %>% pull(Key)
cohorts[["Chen_Lab"]]         <- study_list %>% filter(Is_Chen) %>% pull(Key)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. METRICS COMPUTATION
# ==============================================================================
compute_stability_metrics <- function(cohort_name, keys, db_prefix) {

  message(paste("Computing metrics:", cohort_name, "|", db_prefix))

  meta_path <- file.path(GSEA_DIR, paste0(cohort_name, "_GSEA_Module_results.csv"))
  if (!file.exists(meta_path)) {
    message("  -> Skipping: Meta-Signature file not found.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  meta_data <- read_csv(meta_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(grepl(paste0("^", db_prefix), pathway)) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, Meta_NES = NES, Meta_FDR = padj)

  if (nrow(meta_data) == 0) return(NULL)

  all_csvs   <- list.files(GSEA_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  indiv_list <- list()

  for (k in keys) {
    match <- all_csvs[grepl(paste0("/", k, "_"), all_csvs) | grepl(paste0("\\\\", k, "_"), all_csvs)]
    if (length(match) > 0) {
      df <- read_csv(match[1], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        filter(grepl(paste0("^", db_prefix), pathway))
      if (nrow(df) > 0) indiv_list[[k]] <- df %>% mutate(Key = k)
    }
  }

  if (length(indiv_list) < 2) {
    message("  -> Skipping: Not enough individual files.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  combined_indiv <- bind_rows(indiv_list)

  metrics <- combined_indiv %>%
    group_by(pathway) %>%
    summarise(
      n_sig          = sum(padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_total        = n_distinct(Key),
      Penetrance     = n_sig / n_total,
      n_up           = sum(NES > 0 & padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_down         = sum(NES < 0 & padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
      Concordance    = ifelse(n_sig > 0, abs(n_up - n_down) / n_sig, 0),
      Mean_Indiv_NES = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    inner_join(meta_data, by = "pathway") %>%
    mutate(Stability_Score = Penetrance * Concordance) %>%
    arrange(desc(Stability_Score))

  write_csv(metrics, file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("Stability_Metrics_", cohort_name, "_", db_prefix, ".csv")))

  metrics <- metrics %>%
    slice_head(n = 50) %>%
    mutate(
      clean_name = pathway %>%
        gsub(paste0("^", db_prefix, "_"), "", .) %>%
        str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
        str_to_title()
    )

  message(paste("  -> Done. Rows:", nrow(metrics),
                "| Penetrance range:", round(min(metrics$Penetrance), 2), "-", round(max(metrics$Penetrance), 2),
                "| NES range:", round(min(metrics$Mean_Indiv_NES), 2), "-", round(max(metrics$Mean_Indiv_NES), 2)))

  return(as.data.frame(metrics))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 3. PLOT BUILDER — LOLLIPOP
# ==============================================================================
build_lollipop_plot <- function(metrics, title_label,
                                n_show      = 12,
                                nes_limits  = NULL,
                                pen_limits  = c(0, 1),
                                x_limits    = c(0, 1),
                                wrap_width  = 26,
                                show_legend = TRUE) {

  if (is.null(metrics)) stop(paste("metrics is NULL for:", title_label))

  df <- metrics %>%
    arrange(desc(Stability_Score)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_show) %>%
    mutate(
      clean_name = str_wrap(clean_name, width = wrap_width),
      clean_name = fct_reorder(clean_name, Stability_Score)
    )

  if (is.null(nes_limits)) {
    lim <- max(abs(df$Mean_Indiv_NES), na.rm = TRUE)
    nes_limits <- c(-lim, lim)
  }

  ggplot(df, aes(x = Stability_Score, y = clean_name)) +

    # --- the stick ---
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = 0, xend = Stability_Score, y = clean_name, yend = clean_name),
      color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.9
    ) +

    # --- the candy ---
    geom_point(
      aes(fill = Mean_Indiv_NES, size = Penetrance),
      shape = 21, color = "grey25", stroke = 0.8
    ) +

    scale_fill_gradient2(
      name     = "Mean NES",
      low      = "#2166AC", mid = "grey95", high = "#D6604D",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits   = nes_limits
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name   = "Penetrance",
      limits = pen_limits,
      range  = c(4, 13),
      labels = scales::percent
    ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
      limits   = x_limits,
      expand   = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.04)),
      n.breaks = 3
    ) +

    labs(
      title = title_label,
      x     = "Stability Score (Penetrance \u00d7 Concordance)",
      y     = NULL
    ) +

    theme_bw(base_size = 26) +
    theme(
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 30, hjust = 0),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 25, lineheight = 0.85),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 24),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 26),
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 24),
      legend.key.size    = unit(1.3, "cm"),
      legend.position    = if (show_legend) "right" else "none",
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(12, 16, 12, 12)
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_colorbar(order = 1, barheight = unit(6, "cm")),
      size = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(fill = "grey40"))
    )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. GENERATE DUAL LOLLIPOP PLOTS — ONE PER DATABASE
# ==============================================================================
for (db in c("GOBP", "REACTOME")) {

  message(paste("\n--- Generating dual lollipop plot for:", db, "---"))

  metrics_mouse <- compute_stability_metrics("Mouse_All", cohorts[["Mouse_All"]], db)
  metrics_rat   <- compute_stability_metrics("Rat_All",   cohorts[["Rat_All"]],   db)

  if (is.null(metrics_mouse) || is.null(metrics_rat)) {
    message(paste("  -> Skipping combined plot for", db, ": one or both cohorts missing."))
    next
  }

  N_SHOW     <- 11
  WRAP_WIDTH <- 26

  top_m <- metrics_mouse %>% arrange(desc(Stability_Score)) %>% slice_head(n = N_SHOW)
  top_r <- metrics_rat   %>% arrange(desc(Stability_Score)) %>% slice_head(n = N_SHOW)

  nes_lim <- max(abs(c(top_m$Mean_Indiv_NES, top_r$Mean_Indiv_NES)), na.rm = TRUE)
  nes_lim <- c(-nes_lim, nes_lim)
  pen_lim <- c(0, 1)

  x_min <- min(c(top_m$Stability_Score, top_r$Stability_Score), na.rm = TRUE)
  x_max <- max(c(top_m$Stability_Score, top_r$Stability_Score), na.rm = TRUE)
  x_lim <- c(max(0, x_min - 0.05), x_max * 1.05)

  p_mouse <- build_lollipop_plot(metrics_mouse, "Mouse",
                                 n_show = N_SHOW, nes_limits = nes_lim,
                                 pen_limits = pen_lim, x_limits = x_lim,
                                 wrap_width = WRAP_WIDTH,
                                 show_legend = FALSE)

  p_rat   <- build_lollipop_plot(metrics_rat, "Rat",
                                 n_show = N_SHOW, nes_limits = nes_lim,
                                 pen_limits = pen_lim, x_limits = x_lim,
                                 wrap_width = WRAP_WIDTH,
                                 show_legend = TRUE)

  combined <- p_mouse + p_rat +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = paste("Pathway Stability Analysis \u2014", db),
      subtitle = "Ranked by Stability Score  |  Fill: Mean NES  |  Size: Penetrance",
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 32, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40")
      )
    ) &
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  ggsave(
    file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0("Lollipop_Mouse_Rat_", db, "_Combined.png")),
    combined,
    width  = 22,
    height = 12,
    dpi    = 300
  )

  message(paste("  -> Saved:", paste0("Lollipop_Mouse_Rat_", db, "_Combined.png")))
}

message("\nAnalysis Complete. Plots saved to: ", OUTPUT_DIR)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Single-Cell Deconvolution — Stacked Dot Plot (Mouse over Rat)
# Text scaled ~1.5x; canvas changed to portrait (taller than wide)
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 0. PATHS
# ==============================================================================
BASE_DIR  <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

MOUSE_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "SingleCellDeconvolution/SigatlasMice/Stats_CSVs_Per_Signature")
RAT_DIR   <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "SingleCellDeconvolution/SigatlasCustomRat/Stats_CSVs")
PLOT_DIR  <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Figures/Supplement")

if (!dir.exists(PLOT_DIR)) dir.create(PLOT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

DIR_COLS <- c(Increased = "#D6604D", Decreased = "#2166AC")

SANS <- "Helvetica"   # sans-serif throughout; use "sans" on Linux

# ---- Figure dimensions: portrait ----
FIG_W <- 9
FIG_H <- 14

# ==============================================================================
# 1. HELPERS
# ==============================================================================
extract_mouse_tissue <- function(fname) {
  stem    <- str_remove(basename(fname), "\\.csv$")
  after_s <- str_match(stem, "_S_([^_]+)")[, 2]
  if (is.na(after_s)) return(NA_character_)
  str_remove(after_s, "-.*$")
}

extract_rat_tissue <- function(fname) {
  stem <- str_remove(basename(fname), "\\.csv$")
  str_match(stem, "^Stats_([A-Za-z]+)")[, 2]
}

REQ_COLS <- c("Cell_Type", "Difference_In_Means", "P_Value",
              "Adjusted_P_Value_BH", "Significance")

read_stats <- function(fp) {
  df <- read_csv(fp, show_col_types = FALSE)
  missing <- setdiff(REQ_COLS, names(df))
  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    stop(sprintf("File %s missing columns: %s",
                 basename(fp), paste(missing, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  df
}

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LOAD + AGGREGATE MOUSE
# ==============================================================================
message("--- Loading mouse signature files ---")
mouse_files <- list.files(MOUSE_DIR, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(mouse_files) == 0) stop("No mouse CSVs found in: ", MOUSE_DIR)

mouse_raw <- map_dfr(mouse_files, function(fp) {
  tis <- extract_mouse_tissue(fp)
  if (is.na(tis)) return(NULL)
  read_stats(fp) %>%
    mutate(Tissue = tis, .keep = "all")
})

message(sprintf("  Mouse rows loaded (matched tissues): %d across %d tissues",
                nrow(mouse_raw), n_distinct(mouse_raw$Tissue)))

mouse_agg <- mouse_raw %>%
  filter(Significance != "ns") %>%
  group_by(Tissue, Cell_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Diff = mean(Difference_In_Means, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sig     = n(),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

message(sprintf("  Mouse aggregated cell-type rows (significant-only avg): %d",
                nrow(mouse_agg)))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. LOAD RAT
# ==============================================================================
message("--- Loading rat tissue files ---")
rat_files <- list.files(RAT_DIR, pattern = "_GLP_vs_Vehicle\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(rat_files) == 0) stop("No rat CSVs found in: ", RAT_DIR)

rat_agg <- map_dfr(rat_files, function(fp) {
  tis <- extract_rat_tissue(fp)
  if (is.na(tis)) return(NULL)
  read_stats(fp) %>%
    filter(Significance != "ns") %>%
    transmute(Tissue = tis, Cell_Type, Mean_Diff = Difference_In_Means)
})

message(sprintf("  Rat significant cell-type rows loaded: %d across %d tissues",
                nrow(rat_agg), n_distinct(rat_agg$Tissue)))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. SHARED PREP — direction, tissue factor, top-3 labels per tissue
# ==============================================================================
prep_panel <- function(df) {
  tissue_levels <- sort(unique(df$Tissue))
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Mean_Diff)) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = if_else(Mean_Diff >= 0, "Increased", "Decreased"),
      Tissue    = factor(Tissue, levels = tissue_levels)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Tissue) %>%
    mutate(
      rank_in_tissue = rank(-abs(Mean_Diff), ties.method = "first"),
      lbl            = if_else(rank_in_tissue <= 3, Cell_Type, NA_character_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

mouse_plot <- prep_panel(mouse_agg)
rat_plot   <- prep_panel(rat_agg)

max_abs <- max(abs(c(mouse_plot$Mean_Diff, rat_plot$Mean_Diff)), na.rm = TRUE)
clamp   <- ceiling(max_abs * 10) / 10
x_limits <- c(-clamp, clamp)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. PANEL BUILDER
# ==============================================================================
build_panel <- function(df, panel_title, show_x_axis = TRUE) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = Mean_Diff, y = Tissue, color = Direction)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#2166AC", alpha = 0.04) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#D6604D", alpha = 0.04) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = lbl),
      size            = 6,          # was 3
      fontface        = "italic",
      family          = SANS,
      na.rm           = TRUE,
      max.overlaps    = Inf,
      box.padding     = 0.6,
      point.padding   = 0.4,
      segment.color   = "grey60",
      segment.size    = 0.3,
      min.segment.length = 0,
      show.legend     = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = DIR_COLS, name = "Direction", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_limits, n.breaks = 5) +   # fewer breaks: narrow axis
    scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(levels(df$Tissue))) +
    labs(
      title = panel_title,
      x     = if (show_x_axis) "Difference in enrichment score (GLP \u2212 Vehicle)" else NULL,
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16, base_family = SANS) +          # was 11
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0),   # was 12
      axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),              # was 11
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 15),                             # was 10
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 16),                             # was 11
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",                 # moved: saves horizontal space
      legend.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      legend.text   = element_text(size = 15),
      plot.margin   = margin(10, 14, 6, 10)
    )
}

p_mouse <- build_panel(mouse_plot, "Mouse",  show_x_axis = FALSE)
p_rat   <- build_panel(rat_plot,   "Rat",    show_x_axis = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. STACK (mouse over rat) + shared legend
# ==============================================================================
combined <- p_mouse / p_rat +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title    = "Marker-Based Deconvolution \u2014 Cell Type Enrichment Changes",
    subtitle = "GLP-1 agonist vs. Vehicle  |  Red = increased, Blue = decreased  |  Top 3 cell types per tissue labeled (by |\u0394|)",
    theme    = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 21, hjust = 0.5, family = SANS),  # was 14
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, color = "grey40", family = SANS) # was 9.5
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# ==============================================================================
# 7. SAVE
# ==============================================================================
out_path <- file.path(PLOT_DIR, "Deconvolution_Stacked_MouseRat.png")
ggsave(
  out_path,
  plot   = combined,
  width  = FIG_W,
  height = FIG_H,
  dpi    = 300,
  bg     = "white"
)
message("\nSaved: ", out_path)

out_pdf <- file.path(PLOT_DIR, "Deconvolution_Stacked_MouseRat.pdf")
ggsave(out_pdf, plot = combined, width = FIG_W, height = FIG_H, bg = "white", device = cairo_pdf)
message("Saved: ", out_pdf)

message("Done.")
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 10_figure_discordance.R
# Publication figure: diverging dumbbell of tissue-discordant metabolic pathways.
# Five Hallmark metabolic pathways, each with adipose (left, suppressed) and
# heart + liver (right, activated) median-NES points, connected across zero.
#
# Pulls values straight from discordance_table so the figure regenerates if the
# data changes. Renders to PDF (vector) and PNG (300 dpi) for the manuscript.
#
# Reads:  discordance_table.rds   (median NES per cohort per pathway)
# Writes: Fig_discordance_dumbbell.pdf / .png
# =============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
})

chenlab_root <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab"
fss          <- file.path(chenlab_root, "semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide")
OUT_DIR      <- file.path(fss, "Tissue_Concordance_analysis")

DISC_RDS <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "discordance_table.rds")
disc <- if (file.exists(DISC_RDS)) readRDS(DISC_RDS) else
  readr::read_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "discordance_table.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# The five representative metabolic pathways (robust in BOTH Heart-WAT and Liver-WAT)
FOCUS <- c(
  "HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM",
  "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",
  "HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS",
  "HALLMARK_XENOBIOTIC_METABOLISM",
  "HALLMARK_PEROXISOME"
)
# Display order (top -> bottom) and clean labels
LABELS <- c(
  HALLMARK_FATTY_ACID_METABOLISM     = "Fatty acid metabolism",
  HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION = "Oxidative phosphorylation",
  HALLMARK_ADIPOGENESIS              = "Adipogenesis",
  HALLMARK_XENOBIOTIC_METABOLISM     = "Xenobiotic metabolism",
  HALLMARK_PEROXISOME                = "Peroxisome"
)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract per-tissue median NES for the focus pathways from the discordance rows.
# discordance_table stores med_A / med_B per (cohort_A, cohort_B). We harvest:
#   adipose value  from any WAT-involving pair (med on the WAT side)
#   heart value    from a Heart-involving pair
#   liver value    from a Liver-involving pair
# Build a tidy (pathway, tissue, nes) frame.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_tissue_nes <- function(df, tissue) {
  # gather every (pathway, NES) where `tissue` appears as cohort_A or cohort_B
  a <- df %>% dplyr::filter(database == "hallmark", cohort_A == tissue) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, nes = med_A)
  b <- df %>% dplyr::filter(database == "hallmark", cohort_B == tissue) %>%
    dplyr::select(pathway, nes = med_B)
  dplyr::bind_rows(a, b) %>%
    dplyr::filter(pathway %in% FOCUS) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(pathway) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(nes = dplyr::first(nes), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(tissue = tissue)
}

plot_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  get_tissue_nes(disc, "White Adipose Tissue") %>% dplyr::mutate(tissue = "Adipose"),
  get_tissue_nes(disc, "Heart") %>% dplyr::mutate(tissue = "Heart"),
  get_tissue_nes(disc, "Liver") %>% dplyr::mutate(tissue = "Liver")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label  = factor(LABELS[pathway], levels = rev(unname(LABELS))),
    tissue = factor(tissue, levels = c("Adipose","Heart","Liver"))
  )

# Segment endpoints per pathway: from min tissue NES to max tissue NES (spans zero)
seg_df <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(label) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(x = min(nes), xend = max(nes), .groups = "drop")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Colors (match the mockup): adipose blue, heart coral, liver amber
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pal <- c("Adipose" = "#378ADD", "Heart" = "#D85A30", "Liver" = "#EF9F27")

p <- ggplot() +
  # zero reference
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey20") +
  # connecting dumbbell bar
  geom_segment(data = seg_df,
               aes(y = label, yend = label, x = x, xend = xend),
               color = "grey70", linewidth = 1.1) +
  # tissue points
  geom_point(data = plot_df,
             aes(x = nes, y = label, fill = tissue),
             shape = 21, size = 4.2, stroke = 0.5, color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)",
    limits = c(-3, 3.7), breaks = seq(-3, 3, 1)
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = -1.5, y = 5.7, label = "suppressed in adipose",
           hjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#185FA5", fontface = "plain") +
  annotate("text", x =  1.9, y = 5.7, label = "activated in heart & liver",
           hjust = 0.5, size = 3.5, color = "#993C1D", fontface = "plain") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0.5, 6.1), clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey10"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey35"),
    axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "grey25", margin = margin(t = 8)),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.4),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 10.5),
    plot.margin  = margin(10, 18, 10, 14)
  )

ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig_discordance_dumbbell.pdf"), p,
       width = 7.2, height = 4.0, device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "Fig_discordance_dumbbell.png"), p,
       width = 7.2, height = 4.0, dpi = 300)

cat("Wrote:\n  Fig_discordance_dumbbell.pdf\n  Fig_discordance_dumbbell.png\n")
cat("\nPlotted values:\n")
plot_df %>% dplyr::select(pathway, tissue, nes) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(pathway, tissue) %>% as.data.frame() %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# ==============================================================================
# SCRIPT: Figure 3 — Stouffer Forest + Sample-Size  (THREE-COLUMN layout)
#
# This is the two-column script adapted to lay the disease signatures out in
# THREE equal column-groups instead of two. Only three sections changed:
#   - Section 6  : split into three (near-)equal groups by median
#   - Section 10 : per-group width recomputed for 3 groups + 2 inter-group gaps
#   - Section 12 : figure gtable now holds three groups side by side
# All statistics and grob builders are untouched.
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(grid)
  library(gtable)
  library(scales)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================
base_dir <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

results_csv_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026.csv")
meta_path        <- file.path(base_dir, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")
sample_size_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/EHRstuff/Sample_Size/Sample_Size_Individual_Disease_Whole_MSDWlatest.csv")
output_plot_dir  <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures/Figure_3")

min_signatures <- 1

# ---- Physical layout budget ----
FIG_WIDTH_MM   <- 185          # hard width ceiling (journal double-column)
A4_HEIGHT_MM   <- 297
USABLE_H_MM    <- 270

# ---- Typography (points) ----
FS_PRIMARY     <- 4.6
FS_SECONDARY   <- 3.9
FS_AXIS        <- 4.4
FS_AXIS_TITLE  <- 5.0
FS_LEGEND      <- 5.0
SANS           <- "sans"

# ---- Label wrapping ----
WRAP_PRIMARY   <- 24
WRAP_SECONDARY <- 44

# ---- Line caps ----
MAX_LINES_PRIMARY   <- 2
MAX_LINES_SECONDARY <- 1
MAX_LINES_TOTAL     <- MAX_LINES_PRIMARY + MAX_LINES_SECONDARY

# ---- Row geometry (mm) ----
LINE_H_MM      <- 2.0
ROW_PAD_MM     <- 0.7
JITTER_HEIGHT  <- 0.12

# ---- Forest x-range ----
X_LIMITS       <- c(-10, 5)
X_BREAKS       <- seq(-10, 5, by = 5)

# ---- Colors ----
COL_INDUCED    <- "#C0392B"
COL_REVERSED   <- "#2E86C1"
COL_NS         <- "grey70"
COL_JITTER     <- "grey60"
BAR_FILL       <- "#5D6D7E"

if (!dir.exists(output_plot_dir)) dir.create(output_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LOAD & CLEAN
# ==============================================================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
all_results <- read_csv(results_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
meta        <- read_excel(meta_path)

merged_results <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Key = str_remove(Drug_Signature, "_DESeq2_results.csv")) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Key") %>%
  distinct(Key, Disease_Signature, .keep_all = TRUE)


plot_data_raw <- merged_results %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Key, "_S_") | str_detect(Key, "_s_") |
      (if ("perturbation" %in% names(.)) str_detect(perturbation, regex("Semaglutide", ignore_case = TRUE)) else FALSE)
  ) 

cat(sprintf("Remaining signatures: %d\n", nrow(plot_data_raw)))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. STOUFFER STATS + BH CORRECTION
# ==============================================================================
get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  c(median     = median(x),
    n          = n,
    stouffer_z = sum(x) / sqrt(n),
    p_val_raw  = 2 * pnorm(-abs(sum(x) / sqrt(n))))
}

stats_df <- plot_data_raw %>%
  group_by(Disease_Name) %>%
  summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest_wider(stats) %>%
  filter(n >= min_signatures) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_val_adj = p.adjust(p_val_raw, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median > 0 ~ 1,
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median < 0 ~ -1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    dot_color = case_when(
      sig ==  1 ~ COL_INDUCED,
      sig == -1 ~ COL_REVERSED,
      TRUE      ~ COL_NS
    )
  )

cat(sprintf("Total diseases to plot: %d\n", nrow(stats_df)))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. JOIN SAMPLE SIZES + DISPLAY NAMES
# ==============================================================================
ss_raw <- read_csv(sample_size_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  left_join(
    ss_raw %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        Disease_Name = str_remove_all(Original_Disease_Name, "\\*"),
        DISPLAY_NAME = if_else(is.na(DISPLAY_NAME) | str_trim(DISPLAY_NAME) == "",
                               NA_character_, DISPLAY_NAME)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(Disease_Name, DISPLAY_NAME, sample_size = SAMPLE_SIZE),
    by = "Disease_Name"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(DISPLAY_NAME = coalesce(DISPLAY_NAME, Disease_Name))

unmatched <- stats_df %>% filter(is.na(sample_size)) %>% pull(Disease_Name)
if (length(unmatched) > 0) {
  cat("WARNING - diseases with no sample-size match:\n")
  cat(paste(" -", unmatched, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}

max_sample_size <- max(stats_df$sample_size, na.rm = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. WRAP LABELS + MEASURE LINE COUNT PER ROW
# ==============================================================================
wrap_lines <- function(s, width, max_lines = Inf) {
  if (is.na(s) || s == "") return("")
  s2      <- str_replace_all(s, "-", " ")
  wrapped <- str_wrap(s2, width = width)
  lines   <- str_split(wrapped, "\n")[[1]]
  if (length(lines) > max_lines) {
    lines <- lines[seq_len(max_lines)]
    last  <- lines[max_lines]
    if (nchar(last) > width - 1) last <- str_trunc(last, width, ellipsis = "\u2026")
    else                         last <- paste0(last, "\u2026")
    lines[max_lines] <- last
  }
  paste(lines, collapse = "\n")
}

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    primary_wrapped   = map_chr(Disease_Name, wrap_lines, width = WRAP_PRIMARY,   max_lines = MAX_LINES_PRIMARY),
    secondary_wrapped = map_chr(DISPLAY_NAME, wrap_lines, width = WRAP_SECONDARY, max_lines = MAX_LINES_SECONDARY),
    n_lines_primary   = str_count(primary_wrapped,   "\n") + 1,
    n_lines_secondary = str_count(secondary_wrapped, "\n") + 1,
    n_lines_total     = n_lines_primary + n_lines_secondary
  )

cat(sprintf("Label line counts: min=%d, median=%g, max=%d lines/row\n",
            min(stats_df$n_lines_total),
            median(stats_df$n_lines_total),
            max(stats_df$n_lines_total)))

# ==============================================================================
# 6. SORT + SPLIT INTO THREE (NEAR-)EQUAL COLUMN-GROUPS BY MEDIAN
#    CHANGED FROM TWO COLUMNS -> THREE COLUMNS.
#    The N diseases are sorted by median, then chopped into three contiguous
#    slices of as-equal-as-possible size (e.g. 104 -> 35 / 35 / 34). Using
#    contiguous slices keeps each column internally sorted by effect size,
#    exactly as the two-column version did.
# ==============================================================================
sorted <- stats_df %>% arrange(median)
n_total <- nrow(sorted)

# split indices into 3 groups, front-loading the remainder so earlier groups
# get the extra row(s) when n_total is not divisible by 3.
grp_id  <- cut(seq_len(n_total),
               breaks = c(0, ceiling((1:3) * n_total / 3)),
               labels = FALSE)

g1_df <- sorted[grp_id == 1, ]
g2_df <- sorted[grp_id == 2, ]
g3_df <- sorted[grp_id == 3, ]

# Within each group, reverse so most-negative sits at TOP (top->bottom order).
g1_df <- g1_df %>% arrange(desc(median))
g2_df <- g2_df %>% arrange(desc(median))
g3_df <- g3_df %>% arrange(desc(median))

# ==============================================================================
# 7. ROW HEIGHTS (mm) — ONE shared vector per column-group
# ==============================================================================
row_heights_mm <- function(df) {
  pmax(df$n_lines_total * LINE_H_MM + ROW_PAD_MM, 3.0)
}

g1_rh <- row_heights_mm(g1_df)
g2_rh <- row_heights_mm(g2_df)
g3_rh <- row_heights_mm(g3_df)

cat(sprintf("Group 1 height: %.1f mm (%d rows)\n", sum(g1_rh), nrow(g1_df)))
cat(sprintf("Group 2 height: %.1f mm (%d rows)\n", sum(g2_rh), nrow(g2_df)))
cat(sprintf("Group 3 height: %.1f mm (%d rows)\n", sum(g3_rh), nrow(g3_df)))

# ==============================================================================
# 8. GROB BUILDERS  (unchanged)
# ==============================================================================
build_label_gtable <- function(df, row_rh) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  gt <- gtable(widths = unit(1, "null"), heights = unit(row_rh, "mm"))

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    row_h <- row_rh[i]
    np    <- df$n_lines_primary[i]
    ns    <- df$n_lines_secondary[i]
    total_text_mm <- (np + ns) * LINE_H_MM

    top_gap <- (row_h - total_text_mm) / 2
    if (top_gap < 0) top_gap <- 0

    grobs <- list()

    p_lines <- str_split(df$primary_wrapped[i], "\n")[[1]]
    for (k in seq_along(p_lines)) {
      y_mm <- top_gap + (k - 0.5) * LINE_H_MM
      grobs <- c(grobs, list(
        textGrob(p_lines[k],
                 x = unit(2, "pt"),
                 y = unit(row_h - y_mm, "mm"),
                 just = c("left", "center"),
                 gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_PRIMARY, fontfamily = SANS,
                           col = "grey15", lineheight = 0.9))
      ))
    }

    s_lines <- str_split(df$secondary_wrapped[i], "\n")[[1]]
    for (k in seq_along(s_lines)) {
      y_mm <- top_gap + (np + k - 0.5) * LINE_H_MM
      grobs <- c(grobs, list(
        textGrob(s_lines[k],
                 x = unit(2, "pt"),
                 y = unit(row_h - y_mm, "mm"),
                 just = c("left", "center"),
                 gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_SECONDARY, fontfamily = SANS,
                           col = "grey50", fontface = "italic", lineheight = 0.9))
      ))
    }

    gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, do.call(grobTree, grobs), t = i, l = 1,
                          clip = "off", name = paste0("label_", i))
  }
  gt
}

x_to_npc <- function(x) (x - X_LIMITS[1]) / (X_LIMITS[2] - X_LIMITS[1])

build_forest_gtable <- function(df, row_rh, raw_data) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  gt <- gtable(widths = unit(1, "null"), heights = unit(row_rh, "mm"))

  zero_npc <- x_to_npc(0)

  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    dn   <- df$Disease_Name[i]
    pts  <- raw_data$Z_Score_Median[raw_data$Disease_Name == dn]
    pts  <- pts[!is.na(pts) & pts >= X_LIMITS[1] & pts <= X_LIMITS[2]]

    grobs <- list(
      segmentsGrob(x0 = unit(zero_npc, "npc"), x1 = unit(zero_npc, "npc"),
                   y0 = unit(0, "npc"), y1 = unit(1, "npc"),
                   gp = gpar(col = "grey60", lty = "dashed", lwd = 0.4))
    )

    if (length(pts) > 0) {
      jy <- 0.5 + runif(length(pts), -JITTER_HEIGHT, JITTER_HEIGHT)
      grobs <- c(grobs, list(
        pointsGrob(x = unit(x_to_npc(pts), "npc"), y = unit(jy, "npc"),
                   pch = 16, size = unit(0.7, "mm"),
                   gp = gpar(col = COL_JITTER, alpha = 0.28))
      ))
    }

    grobs <- c(grobs, list(
      pointsGrob(x = unit(x_to_npc(df$median[i]), "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"),
                 pch = 16, size = unit(2.4, "mm"),
                 gp = gpar(col = df$dot_color[i]))
    ))

    gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, do.call(grobTree, grobs),
                          t = i, l = 1, clip = "on",
                          name = paste0("forest_", i))
  }
  gt
}

sqrt_to_npc <- function(v) sqrt(pmax(v, 0)) / sqrt(max_sample_size * 1.1)

build_bar_gtable <- function(df, row_rh) {
  n <- nrow(df)
  gt <- gtable(widths = unit(1, "null"), heights = unit(row_rh, "mm"))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    ss <- df$sample_size[i]
    grobs <- list(
      segmentsGrob(x0 = unit(0, "npc"), x1 = unit(0, "npc"),
                   y0 = unit(0, "npc"), y1 = unit(1, "npc"),
                   gp = gpar(col = "grey85", lwd = 0.3))
    )
    if (!is.na(ss) && ss > 0) {
      w <- sqrt_to_npc(ss)
      grobs <- c(grobs, list(
        rectGrob(x = unit(0, "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"),
                 width = unit(w, "npc"), height = unit(0.6, "npc"),
                 just = c("left", "center"),
                 gp = gpar(fill = BAR_FILL, col = NA))
      ))
    }
    gt <- gtable_add_grob(gt, do.call(grobTree, grobs),
                          t = i, l = 1, clip = "off",
                          name = paste0("bar_", i))
  }
  gt
}

# ==============================================================================
# 9. AXIS STRIPS  (unchanged)
# ==============================================================================
build_forest_axis <- function() {
  ticks <- x_to_npc(X_BREAKS)
  grobTree(
    segmentsGrob(x0 = unit(ticks, "npc"), x1 = unit(ticks, "npc"),
                 y0 = unit(0.78, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.92, "npc"),
                 gp = gpar(lwd = 0.4, col = "grey30")),
    textGrob(as.character(X_BREAKS), x = unit(ticks, "npc"),
             y = unit(0.60, "npc"),
             gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_AXIS, fontfamily = SANS, col = "grey25")),
    textGrob("Median Z-Score", x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.18, "npc"),
             gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_AXIS_TITLE, fontfamily = SANS, fontface = "bold"))
  )
}

build_bar_axis <- function() {
  brks <- pretty(c(0, max_sample_size), n = 3)
  brks <- brks[brks > 0 & brks <= max_sample_size * 1.1]
  ticks <- sqrt_to_npc(brks)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, length(ticks))
  if (length(ticks) > 1) {
    last_kept <- ticks[1]
    for (j in 2:length(ticks)) {
      if (ticks[j] - last_kept < 0.14) keep[j] <- FALSE else last_kept <- ticks[j]
    }
  }
  brks  <- brks[keep]; ticks <- ticks[keep]
  compact_lbl <- scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())(brks)
  lbl_just <- rep("centre", length(ticks))
  if (length(ticks) > 0 && ticks[length(ticks)] > 0.9) lbl_just[length(ticks)] <- "right"
  grobTree(
    segmentsGrob(x0 = unit(ticks, "npc"), x1 = unit(ticks, "npc"),
                 y0 = unit(0.78, "npc"), y1 = unit(0.92, "npc"),
                 gp = gpar(lwd = 0.4, col = "grey30")),
    textGrob(compact_lbl, x = unit(ticks, "npc"),
             y = unit(0.60, "npc"), hjust = NA,
             gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_AXIS, fontfamily = SANS, col = "grey25")),
    textGrob("Sample Size (N, sqrt scale)", x = unit(0.5, "npc"), y = unit(0.18, "npc"),
             gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_AXIS_TITLE, fontfamily = SANS, fontface = "bold"))
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 10. ASSEMBLE ONE COLUMN-GROUP  (label | forest | bar) + axis row
#     CHANGED: per-group width now divides the figure into THREE groups with
#     TWO inter-group gaps instead of two groups with one gap.
# ==============================================================================
INTERGROUP_GAP_MM <- 5
# three groups + two inter-group gaps must fit the figure width:
GROUP_W_MM        <- (FIG_WIDTH_MM - 2 * INTERGROUP_GAP_MM) / 3   # ~58 mm/group

# within-group widths (mm). The group is narrower now, so the columns are
# tightened proportionally. label still gets the most; forest next; small gap;
# bar takes whatever remains. Adjust these four if you want a different
# label/forest/bar balance within each (narrower) group.
W_LABEL_MM        <- 24
W_FOREST_MM       <- 18
FOREST_BAR_GAP_MM <- 3
W_BAR_MM          <- GROUP_W_MM - W_LABEL_MM - W_FOREST_MM - FOREST_BAR_GAP_MM
AXIS_H_MM         <- 9

build_group <- function(df, row_rh, raw_data) {
  body_h <- sum(row_rh)

  g <- gtable(
    widths  = unit(c(W_LABEL_MM, W_FOREST_MM, FOREST_BAR_GAP_MM, W_BAR_MM), "mm"),
    heights = unit(c(body_h, AXIS_H_MM), "mm")
  )

  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, build_label_gtable(df, row_rh),            t = 1, l = 1, clip = "off", name = "labels")
  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, build_forest_gtable(df, row_rh, raw_data), t = 1, l = 2, clip = "on",  name = "forest")
  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, build_bar_gtable(df, row_rh),             t = 1, l = 4, clip = "off", name = "bars")

  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, build_forest_axis(), t = 2, l = 2, clip = "off", name = "forest_axis")
  g <- gtable_add_grob(g, build_bar_axis(),    t = 2, l = 4, clip = "off", name = "bar_axis")
  g
}

# ==============================================================================
# 11. LEGEND STRIP  (unchanged)
# ==============================================================================
build_legend <- function() {
  items <- tibble(
    label = c("Significantly induced (FDR<0.05, median Z>0)",
              "Significantly reversed (FDR<0.05, median Z<0)",
              "Not significant"),
    col   = c(COL_INDUCED, COL_REVERSED, COL_NS),
    x     = c(0.02, 0.36, 0.72)
  )
  grobs <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(items))) {
    grobs <- c(grobs, list(
      pointsGrob(x = unit(items$x[i], "npc"), y = unit(0.5, "npc"),
                 pch = 16, size = unit(2, "mm"), gp = gpar(col = items$col[i])),
      textGrob(items$label[i], x = unit(items$x[i] + 0.012, "npc"),
               y = unit(0.5, "npc"), just = "left",
               gp = gpar(fontsize = FS_LEGEND, fontfamily = SANS, col = "grey20"))
    ))
  }
  do.call(grobTree, grobs)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 12. COMPOSE FULL FIGURE
#     CHANGED: three groups laid out side by side with two inter-group gaps.
# ==============================================================================
g_g1 <- build_group(g1_df, g1_rh, plot_data_raw)
g_g2 <- build_group(g2_df, g2_rh, plot_data_raw)
g_g3 <- build_group(g3_df, g3_rh, plot_data_raw)

# tallest group governs the body height
group_body_h <- max(sum(g1_rh), sum(g2_rh), sum(g3_rh)) + AXIS_H_MM
LEGEND_H_MM  <- 5
TITLE_H_MM   <- 6

figure <- gtable(
  widths  = unit(c(GROUP_W_MM, INTERGROUP_GAP_MM,
                   GROUP_W_MM, INTERGROUP_GAP_MM,
                   GROUP_W_MM), "mm"),
  heights = unit(c(TITLE_H_MM, group_body_h, LEGEND_H_MM), "mm")
)

figure <- gtable_add_grob(
  figure,
  textGrob("Semaglutide Reversal Landscape Across Disease Signatures",
           x = unit(0.5, "npc"), gp = gpar(fontsize = 7, fontface = "bold", fontfamily = SANS)),
  t = 1, l = 1, r = 5, clip = "off", name = "title"
)
figure <- gtable_add_grob(figure, g_g1,          t = 2, l = 1, clip = "off", name = "group_1")
figure <- gtable_add_grob(figure, g_g2,          t = 2, l = 3, clip = "off", name = "group_2")
figure <- gtable_add_grob(figure, g_g3,          t = 2, l = 5, clip = "off", name = "group_3")
figure <- gtable_add_grob(figure, build_legend(), t = 3, l = 1, r = 5, clip = "off", name = "legend")

# ==============================================================================
# 13. REPORT DIMENSIONS + SAVE
# ==============================================================================
total_w_mm <- FIG_WIDTH_MM
total_h_mm <- TITLE_H_MM + group_body_h + LEGEND_H_MM

cat("\n================ FINAL FIGURE DIMENSIONS ================\n")
cat(sprintf("  Width : %.1f mm  (ceiling 185 mm)\n", total_w_mm))
cat(sprintf("  Height: %.1f mm  (A4 = %d mm, usable ~%d mm)\n",
            total_h_mm, A4_HEIGHT_MM, USABLE_H_MM))
if (total_h_mm > USABLE_H_MM) {
  cat(sprintf("  >> OVERFLOW: exceeds usable A4 height by %.1f mm.\n", total_h_mm - USABLE_H_MM))
} else {
  cat("  >> Fits within usable A4 height.\n")
}
cat("========================================================\n\n")

mm2in <- function(mm) mm / 25.4

out_pdf <- file.path(output_plot_dir, "Figure3_Forest_SampleSize_A4_3col.pdf")
out_png <- file.path(output_plot_dir, "Figure3_Forest_SampleSize_A4_3col.png")

pdf(out_pdf, width = mm2in(total_w_mm), height = mm2in(total_h_mm))
grid.newpage(); grid.draw(figure); dev.off()
cat("Saved:", out_pdf, "\n")

png(out_png, width = total_w_mm, height = total_h_mm, units = "mm", res = 600)
grid.newpage(); grid.draw(figure); dev.off()
cat("Saved:", out_png, "\n")

cat("\nDone.\n")
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Performance Heatmap — Semaglutide Reversal Method
# Accuracy / Sensitivity by Evidence Level & Disease Group
#   (Specificity retained in the accuracy table + CSV, dropped from heatmap)
# Source CSV: Semaglutide_Auto_literature_Pipeline_Results.csv
# Output: Figure4a.png
# ==============================================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# ==============================================================================
# 0. PATHS  (OneDrive mount, consistent with the other figure scripts)
# ==============================================================================
base_dir <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

input_csv   <- file.path(base_dir, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Auto_literature_Pipeline_Results.csv")
table_csv   <- file.path(base_dir, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Accuracy_Summary_Table.csv")
heatmap_png <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures/FigureFinal/Figure4a.png")

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================
df <- read.csv(input_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

# Trim whitespace from character columns (common CSV artefact)
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. FILTER & CLASSIFY
# ==============================================================================

# Exclude diseases with no prior literature
df_filtered <- df %>%
  filter(Treat_Null_Contra_None != "None")

# Recode the raw evidence value BEFORE factoring, so the rename matches the
# actual string in the data (otherwise renamed-only factor levels would turn
# the old "Biological Mouse Study" rows into NA and silently drop them).
df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    Evidence_Type = if_else(Evidence_Type == "Biological Mouse Study",
                            "Mouse Model", Evidence_Type)
  )

# Evidence level order (highest -> lowest) — Meta Analysis ranks above Clinical Trial
evidence_levels <- c(
  "FDA approved",
  "Meta Analysis",
  "Clinical Trial",
  "EHR study",
  "Mouse Model"            # renamed from "Biological Mouse Study"
)

df_filtered <- df_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    Evidence_Type = factor(Evidence_Type, levels = evidence_levels),
    # Confusion matrix classification
    CM_Label = case_when(
      # Core confusion matrix
      Significance == "Significantly Reversed"   & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Treatment"       ~ "True Positive",
      Significance == "Significantly Concordant" & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Contraindicated"  ~ "True Negative",
      Significance == "Significantly Reversed"   & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Contraindicated"  ~ "False Positive",
      Significance == "Significantly Concordant" & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Treatment"        ~ "False Negative",
      # Insignificant + Treatment = method failed to detect a real signal = False Negative
      Significance == "Insignificant"            & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Treatment"        ~ "False Negative",
      # Insignificant + Contraindicated = method correctly stayed quiet = True Negative
      Significance == "Insignificant"            & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Contraindicated"  ~ "True Negative",
      # Null-evidence rows — tracked separately, excluded from core metrics
      Significance == "Insignificant"            & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Null"             ~ "True Negative (Null)",
      Significance == "Significantly Reversed"   & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Null"             ~ "False Positive (Null)",
      Significance == "Significantly Concordant" & Treat_Null_Contra_None == "Null"             ~ "False Negative (Null)",
      TRUE ~ "Unclassified"
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. BUILD ACCURACY TABLE FUNCTION  (all five metrics retained here)
# ==============================================================================

build_accuracy_table <- function(data, group_label) {

  core <- data %>%
    filter(Treat_Null_Contra_None %in% c("Treatment", "Contraindicated"))

  summary_tbl <- core %>%
    group_by(Evidence_Type, CM_Label) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    complete(
      Evidence_Type = factor(evidence_levels, levels = evidence_levels),
      CM_Label      = c("True Positive", "True Negative", "False Positive", "False Negative"),
      fill          = list(n = 0)
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = CM_Label, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      `True Positive`  = if ("True Positive"  %in% names(.)) `True Positive`  else 0L,
      `True Negative`  = if ("True Negative"  %in% names(.)) `True Negative`  else 0L,
      `False Positive` = if ("False Positive" %in% names(.)) `False Positive` else 0L,
      `False Negative` = if ("False Negative" %in% names(.)) `False Negative` else 0L
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TP = `True Positive`,
      TN = `True Negative`,
      FP = `False Positive`,
      FN = `False Negative`,
      Total = TP + TN + FP + FN,
      `Accuracy (%)`    = ifelse(Total == 0,         NA, round(100 * (TP + TN) / Total, 1)),
      `Sensitivity (%)`  = ifelse((TP + FN) == 0,    NA, round(100 * TP / (TP + FN), 1)),
      `Specificity (%)`  = ifelse((TN + FP) == 0,    NA, round(100 * TN / (TN + FP), 1)),
      `PPV (%)`          = ifelse((TP + FP) == 0,    NA, round(100 * TP / (TP + FP), 1)),
      `NPV (%)`          = ifelse((TN + FN) == 0,    NA, round(100 * TN / (TN + FN), 1)),
      Group = group_label
    ) %>%
    # Add "All Levels" summary row
    bind_rows(
      data %>%
        filter(Treat_Null_Contra_None %in% c("Treatment", "Contraindicated")) %>%
        summarise(
          TP = sum(CM_Label == "True Positive",  na.rm = TRUE),
          TN = sum(CM_Label == "True Negative",  na.rm = TRUE),
          FP = sum(CM_Label == "False Positive", na.rm = TRUE),
          FN = sum(CM_Label == "False Negative", na.rm = TRUE)
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          Evidence_Type     = factor("All Levels", levels = c(evidence_levels, "All Levels")),
          Total             = TP + TN + FP + FN,
          `Accuracy (%)`    = ifelse(Total == 0,      NA, round(100 * (TP + TN) / Total, 1)),
          `Sensitivity (%)`  = ifelse((TP+FN) == 0,   NA, round(100 * TP / (TP+FN), 1)),
          `Specificity (%)`  = ifelse((TN+FP) == 0,   NA, round(100 * TN / (TN+FP), 1)),
          `PPV (%)`          = ifelse((TP+FP) == 0,   NA, round(100 * TP / (TP+FP), 1)),
          `NPV (%)`          = ifelse((TN+FN) == 0,   NA, round(100 * TN / (TN+FN), 1)),
          Group = group_label
        )
    )

  summary_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(Group, Evidence_Type, TP, TN, FP, FN, Total,
           `Accuracy (%)`, `Sensitivity (%)`, `Specificity (%)`,
           `PPV (%)`, `NPV (%)`)
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. RUN FOR ALL THREE GROUPS
# ==============================================================================

tbl_all        <- build_accuracy_table(df_filtered, "All Diseases")
tbl_cancer     <- build_accuracy_table(
  filter(df_filtered, `Cancer_Non.Cancer` == "Cancer"),     "Cancer")
tbl_non_cancer <- build_accuracy_table(
  filter(df_filtered, `Cancer_Non.Cancer` == "Non-Cancer"), "Non-Cancer")

master_table <- bind_rows(tbl_all, tbl_cancer, tbl_non_cancer)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. PRINT TO CONSOLE
# ==============================================================================

print_group <- function(tbl, label) {
  cat("\n", strrep("=", 70), "\n")
  cat(" GROUP:", label, "\n")
  cat(strrep("=", 70), "\n")
  print(
    tbl %>%
      filter(Group == label) %>%
      dplyr::select(-Group) %>%
      mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0))),
    n = Inf
  )
}

print_group(master_table, "All Diseases")
print_group(master_table, "Cancer")
print_group(master_table, "Non-Cancer")

# ==============================================================================
# 6. EXPORT ACCURACY TABLE TO CSV  (Specificity retained here)
# ==============================================================================

write.csv(master_table, table_csv, row.names = FALSE, na = "N/A")
cat("\n\u2713 Accuracy table saved:", table_csv, "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# 7. HEATMAPS — Two separate figures
#    Figure 4a: Accuracy only
#    Figure 4a_Full: Accuracy + Sensitivity + Specificity
#    Text scaled ~1.5x; tiles narrowed/shortened to make room
# ==============================================================================

if (!dir.exists(dirname(heatmap_png))) dir.create(dirname(heatmap_png), recursive = TRUE)

# --- Shared long-format data (all three metrics) ---
heatmap_df_full <- master_table %>%
  filter(Evidence_Type != "All Levels") %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, Evidence_Type,
                Accuracy    = `Accuracy (%)`,
                Sensitivity = `Sensitivity (%)`,
                Specificity = `Specificity (%)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Accuracy, Sensitivity, Specificity),
               names_to  = "Metric",
               values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(
    Evidence_Type = factor(Evidence_Type, levels = rev(evidence_levels)),
    Group         = factor(Group,  levels = c("All Diseases", "Cancer", "Non-Cancer")),
    Metric        = factor(Metric, levels = c("Accuracy", "Sensitivity", "Specificity"))
  )

# --- Shared plot builder ---
build_heatmap <- function(data, title_suffix, ncol_facet) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Group, y = Evidence_Type, fill = Value)) +

    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1.0) +   # full-size tiles again

    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = ifelse(is.na(Value), "N/A", paste0(Value, "%")),
        color = ifelse(!is.na(Value) & Value > 60, "white", "gray30")
      ),
      size = 7.5, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colors   = c("#d73027", "#fee08b", "#1a9850"),
      values   = scales::rescale(c(0, 50, 100)),
      limits   = c(0, 100),
      na.value = "grey85",
      name     = "Value (%)"
    ) +

    # THIS is what shrinks the panel: each cell is forced to a fixed aspect
    coord_fixed(ratio = 0.55) +

    facet_wrap(~Metric, ncol = ncol_facet) +
    labs(
      title    = paste("Semaglutide Reversal Method Performance —", title_suffix),
      subtitle = "Green = strong | Red = weak | Grey = no data",
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "Evidence Level (highest \u2192 lowest)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 24) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 26),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 19),
      strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 23),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 23),
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 22),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 22, angle = 20, hjust = 1),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 23, face = "bold"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 21),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing   = unit(1.6, "lines"),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.margin     = margin(14, 16, 14, 14)
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(5.5, "cm")))
}

# --- Plot 1: Accuracy only ---
p_accuracy <- build_heatmap(
  data         = filter(heatmap_df_full, Metric == "Accuracy"),
  title_suffix = "Accuracy",
  ncol_facet   = 1
)

ggsave(heatmap_png, p_accuracy, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("\u2713 Figure 4a (Accuracy) saved:", heatmap_png, "\n")

# --- Plot 2: Accuracy + Sensitivity + Specificity ---
heatmap_png_full <- sub("Figure4a.png", "Figure4a_Full.png", heatmap_png)

p_full <- build_heatmap(
  data         = heatmap_df_full,
  title_suffix = "Accuracy, Sensitivity & Specificity",
  ncol_facet   = 3
)

ggsave(heatmap_png_full, p_full, width = 22, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
cat("\u2713 Figure 4a_Full (Accuracy + Sensitivity + Specificity) saved:", heatmap_png_full, "\n")
```
