# ==============================================================================
# Pairwise Scatter Matrix — Semaglutide vs SGLT2i vs Doxorubicin
# Text enlarged; per-disease labels removed
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(cowplot)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# ==============================================================================

BASE_DIR <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

sema_csv   <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026.csv")
sema_meta  <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")
sglt2_csv  <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "SGLT2is/Reversal_Results/SGLT2i_Reversal_Scores_Named.csv")
dox_csv    <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Doxorubicin/Reversal_Results/Doxorubicin_Reversal_Scores_Named.csv")
output_dir <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Comparison_Plots/Consistency_Analysis")

min_signatures <- 1

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. LOAD DATA
# ==============================================================================

cat("Loading data...\n")

meta     <- read_excel(sema_meta)
sema_raw <- read_csv(sema_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Key = str_remove(Drug_Signature, "_DESeq2_results.csv")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta, by = "Key") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Key, Disease_Signature, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    str_detect(Key, "_S_") | str_detect(Key, "_s_")
  )

sglt2_raw <- read_csv(sglt2_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
dox_raw   <- read_csv(dox_csv,   show_col_types = FALSE)

# ==============================================================================
# 3. STOUFFER MEDIAN Z PER DISEASE
# ==============================================================================

get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x          <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n          <- length(x)
  median_z   <- median(x)
  stouffer_z <- sum(x) / sqrt(n)
  p_val_raw  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(stouffer_z))
  c(median = median_z, n = n, stouffer_z = stouffer_z, p_val_raw = p_val_raw)
}

compute_stats <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Disease_Name) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)),
                     .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(stats) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n >= min_signatures)
}

sema_stats  <- compute_stats(sema_raw)
sglt2_stats <- compute_stats(sglt2_raw)
dox_stats   <- compute_stats(dox_raw)

shared_df <- sema_stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Disease_Name, sema_median = median) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    sglt2_stats %>% dplyr::select(Disease_Name, sglt2_median = median),
    by = "Disease_Name"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    dox_stats %>% dplyr::select(Disease_Name, dox_median = median),
    by = "Disease_Name"
  )

cat(sprintf("Diseases in all three datasets: %d\n\n", nrow(shared_df)))

rho_ss <- cor(shared_df$sema_median,  shared_df$sglt2_median, method = "spearman")
rho_sd <- cor(shared_df$sema_median,  shared_df$dox_median,   method = "spearman")
rho_gd <- cor(shared_df$sglt2_median, shared_df$dox_median,   method = "spearman")

cat(sprintf("Sema vs SGLT2i:    rho = %.3f\n", rho_ss))
cat(sprintf("Sema vs Dox:       rho = %.3f\n", rho_sd))
cat(sprintf("SGLT2i vs Dox:     rho = %.3f\n", rho_gd))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. SCATTER PANEL FUNCTION
# ==============================================================================

make_scatter <- function(x_var, y_var, x_lab, y_lab, rho) {

  rho_label <- sprintf("\u03c1 = %.2f", rho)

  df <- shared_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pair_agree  = sign(.data[[x_var]]) == sign(.data[[y_var]]),
      point_color = ifelse(pair_agree, "#2E8B57", "grey60")
    )

  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = .data[[y_var]])) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dotted",
                color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(color = point_color), size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black",
                linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.15) +
    annotate("text",
             x = Inf, y = -Inf,
             label    = rho_label,
             hjust    = 1.15, vjust = -0.6,
             size     = 10, fontface = "bold",
             color    = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 4) +
    labs(x = x_lab, y = y_lab) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 26) +
    theme(
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 26),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 24),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(10, 12, 10, 10)
    )
}
# ==============================================================================
# 5. ASSEMBLE AND SAVE
# ==============================================================================

p_ss <- make_scatter("sema_median",  "sglt2_median",
                     "Semaglutide Median Z", "SGLT2i Median Z",      rho_ss)
p_sd <- make_scatter("sema_median",  "dox_median",
                     "Semaglutide Median Z", "Doxorubicin Median Z", rho_sd)
p_gd <- make_scatter("sglt2_median", "dox_median",
                     "SGLT2i Median Z",      "Doxorubicin Median Z", rho_gd)

legend_text <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label("\u25cf", x = 0.24, y = 0.5, size = 30, color = "#2E8B57", hjust = 0) +
  draw_label("Both drugs agree on direction",
             x = 0.265, y = 0.5, size = 26, color = "grey30", hjust = 0) +
  draw_label("\u25cf", x = 0.60, y = 0.5, size = 30, color = "grey60", hjust = 0) +
  draw_label("Disagreement",
             x = 0.625, y = 0.5, size = 26, color = "grey30", hjust = 0)

scatter_grid <- plot_grid(p_ss, p_sd, p_gd,
                          ncol       = 3,
                          align      = "hv",
                          labels     = c("A", "B", "C"),
                          label_size = 30)

final_plot <- plot_grid(scatter_grid, legend_text,
                        ncol        = 1,
                        rel_heights = c(1, 0.14))

ggsave(out_path, final_plot, width = 20, height = 8.5, dpi = 300)
cat(sprintf("Saved to: %s\n", out_path))

import pandas as pd

# ── ADD THIS FILTER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rges_raw = rges_raw[
    rges_raw['Drug_Signature'].str.contains('_S_', na=False) 
]

print(f"RGES rows after filter: {len(rges_raw)}")
print(f"Unique Disease_Names remaining: {rges_raw['Disease_Name'].nunique()}")

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 3 — BUILD ROW STRUCTURE (one row per original disease name)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
cdc['orig_list'] = cdc['Original_Disease_Name'].apply(
    lambda x: [s.strip() for s in str(x).split(',')]
)
# Drop bare 'Glioma' — use 'Gliomas' instead
cdc['orig_list'] = cdc['orig_list'].apply(
    lambda lst: [o for o in lst if o.strip() != 'Glioma']
)

rows = []
for _, r in cdc.iterrows():
    for orig in r['orig_list']:
        rows.append({'Display_Name': r['Display_Name'], 'original': orig})
plot_df = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 4 — MERGE OR DATA
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
plot_df = plot_df.merge(
    unexp[['Display_Name','odds_ratio','lower_ci','upper_ci','p_adjusted_bh']].rename(
        columns={'odds_ratio':'or2','lower_ci':'l2','upper_ci':'u2','p_adjusted_bh':'p2'}),
    on='Display_Name', how='left')

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 5 — STOUFFER RGES + BH CORRECTION
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def stouffer_stats(grp):
    z = grp['Z_Score_Median'].dropna().values
    n = len(z)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series({'median_z': np.nan, 'stouffer_z': np.nan,
                          'p_raw': np.nan, 'n_sigs': 0})
    med = np.median(z)
    sz  = z.sum() / np.sqrt(n)
    p   = 2 * stats.norm.sf(abs(sz))
    return pd.Series({'median_z': med, 'stouffer_z': sz, 'p_raw': p, 'n_sigs': n})

rges_stats = rges_raw.groupby('Disease_Name').apply(stouffer_stats).reset_index()

all_originals  = plot_df['original'].unique()
rges_filt      = rges_stats[rges_stats['Disease_Name'].isin(all_originals)].dropna(subset=['p_raw']).copy()
_, p_adj, _, _ = multipletests(rges_filt['p_raw'], method='fdr_bh')
rges_filt['p_adj'] = p_adj

plot_df = plot_df.merge(
    rges_filt[['Disease_Name','median_z','stouffer_z','p_adj','n_sigs']].rename(
        columns={'Disease_Name': 'original'}),
    on='original', how='left')

# ── Diagnostic: show matched / unmatched ─────────────────────────────────
print("\n=== RGES MATCH DIAGNOSTIC ===")
for _, r in plot_df.iterrows():
    status = f"  Z={r['median_z']:.3f}" if not np.isnan(r.get('median_z', np.nan)) else "  *** NO RGES DATA ***"
    print(f"  {r['Display_Name'][:45]:45s} | {r['original']:45s} |{status}")

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 6 — SORT (most reversed → most induced)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
sort_key = plot_df.groupby('Display_Name')['median_z'].median().reset_index()
sort_key.columns = ['Display_Name', 'sort_key']
plot_df = plot_df.merge(sort_key, on='Display_Name')

# Put NaN sort_key (no RGES data) at the very end
plot_df['_sort_nan'] = plot_df['sort_key'].isna().astype(int)
plot_df = plot_df.sort_values(
    ['_sort_nan', 'sort_key', 'Display_Name', 'original'],
    ascending=[True, True, True, True]
).reset_index(drop=True)
plot_df.drop(columns=['_sort_nan'], inplace=True)

N = len(plot_df)
print(f"\nTotal rows: {N} | Unique display names: {plot_df['Display_Name'].nunique()}")

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 7 — OR AXIS LIMITS (log scale, auto from data)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
all_ci  = pd.concat([plot_df['l2'], plot_df['u2']]).dropna()
all_ci  = all_ci[all_ci > 0]
OR_FLOOR   = 0.05
or_min_vis = max(OR_FLOOR, all_ci.min() * 0.80)
or_max_vis = all_ci.max() * 1.20
or_xlim    = (or_min_vis, or_max_vis)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 8 — COLOUR SCHEME
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
C_UNEXP_SIG  = "#034C3A"
C_UNEXP_NS   = "#059D6B"
C_RGES_IND   = "#E34916"   # positive (induced)
C_RGES_REV   = "#114E8A"   # negative (reversed)
C_RGES_NS    = '#BBBBBB'
GRID_COL     = '#EEEEEE'
ALT_ROW      = '#F7F7F7'

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 9 — FIGURE LAYOUT
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ROW_H  = 0.33
FIG_H  = max(12, N * ROW_H + 2.8)
FIG_W  = 24

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(FIG_W, FIG_H), facecolor='white')

# 4 columns: display-label | OR-Unexp | RGES | orig-label
gs = fig.add_gridspec(
    1, 4,
    width_ratios=[3.2, 2.2, 2.0, 2.8],
    left=0.01, right=0.99,
    wspace=0.04,
    top=0.96, bottom=0.07
)
ax_lbl  = fig.add_subplot(gs[0])
ax_or2  = fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
ax_rges = fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
ax_orig = fig.add_subplot(gs[3])

# ── Text-only panels: use data coordinates ────────────────────────────────
for ax in [ax_lbl, ax_orig]:
    ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.5, N - 0.5)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.axis('off')

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 10 — GROUP TRACKING
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
seen = {}          # display_name → list of row indices
grp_idx_list = []
prev_dn = None
grp_idx = 0
for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    dn = row['Display_Name']
    if dn != prev_dn:
        grp_idx += 1
        prev_dn = dn
    grp_idx_list.append(grp_idx)
    if dn not in seen:
        seen[dn] = []
    seen[dn].append(i)
plot_df['grp_idx'] = grp_idx_list

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 11 — ALTERNATING ROW SHADING
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for ax in [ax_or2, ax_rges, ax_lbl, ax_orig]:
    for i, gi in enumerate(plot_df['grp_idx']):
        if gi % 2 == 0:
            ax.axhspan(i - 0.5, i + 0.5, color=ALT_ROW, zorder=0)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 12 — DISPLAY NAME LABELS
# ── Each row: show display name FIRST occurrence BOLD, subsequent = "↳"
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
prev_dn = None
for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    dn = row['Display_Name']
    is_first = (dn != prev_dn)
    prev_dn  = dn
    n_rows   = len(seen[dn])

    if is_first:
        ax_lbl.text(
            0.98, i,                       # data coords: x in [0,1], y = row index
            dn,
            ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=14,
            fontweight='bold' if n_rows > 1 else 'normal',
            color="#020000FF",
            transform=ax_lbl.get_yaxis_transform()   # x=axes, y=data
        )
    else:
        ax_lbl.text(
            0.98, i, '↳',
            ha='right', va='center',
            fontsize=14, color='#BBBBBB',
            transform=ax_lbl.get_yaxis_transform()
        )

ax_lbl.set_title('Disease', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=6)

# ── Group separator lines ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for dn, idxs in seen.items():
    if idxs[-1] < N - 1:
        sep_y = idxs[-1] + 0.5
        for ax in [ax_or2, ax_rges]:
            ax.axhline(sep_y, color='#CCCCCC', linewidth=0.5, zorder=1)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 13 — OR PANELS
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def draw_or_panel(ax, or_col, l_col, u_col, p_col,
                  sig_col, ns_col, title):
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_xlim(or_xlim)
    ax.axvline(1.0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.5, N - 0.5)
    ax.invert_yaxis()
    ax.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
    ax.spines[['top', 'right', 'left']].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(left=False, labelsize=7)
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=6)
    ax.set_xlabel('Odds Ratio (log scale)', fontsize=13)

    for dn, idxs in seen.items():
        sub      = plot_df.loc[idxs[0]]
        or_val   = sub[or_col]
        l_val    = sub[l_col]
        u_val    = sub[u_col]
        p_val    = sub[p_col]
        center_y = np.mean(idxs)
        sig = pd.notna(p_val) and float(p_val) < 0.05
        c   = sig_col if sig else ns_col

        # CI line + caps
        if pd.notna(l_val) and pd.notna(u_val) and l_val > 0 and u_val > 0:
            l_plot = max(float(l_val), or_xlim[0] * 1.01)
            u_plot = min(float(u_val), or_xlim[1] * 0.99)
            ax.plot([l_plot, u_plot], [center_y, center_y],
                    color=c, linewidth=1.3, zorder=2)
            for cap_x in [l_plot, u_plot]:
                ax.plot([cap_x, cap_x], [center_y - 0.2, center_y + 0.2],
                        color=c, linewidth=1.3, zorder=2)

        # OR dot
        if pd.notna(or_val) and float(or_val) > 0:
            or_plot = max(float(or_val), or_xlim[0] * 1.01)
            if sig:
                ax.plot(or_plot, center_y, 'o', color=c,
                        markersize=5.5, zorder=4)
            else:
                ax.plot(or_plot, center_y, 'o', color=c,
                        markerfacecolor='none', markeredgewidth=1.2,
                        markersize=5.5, zorder=4)

            # OR value label — offset below the center line
            label_y = center_y - (0.35 if len(idxs) == 1 else 0.45)
            ax.text(or_plot, label_y, f'{float(or_val):.2f}',
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=11,
                    color=c, zorder=5)

draw_or_panel(ax_or2, 'or2','l2','u2','p2',
              C_UNEXP_SIG, C_UNEXP_NS,
              'Sema vs Unexposed\nOR (95% CI)')

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 14 — RGES PANEL
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rges_abs   = plot_df['median_z'].dropna().abs()
rges_x_lim = rges_abs.max() * 1.15 if len(rges_abs) > 0 else 5
rges_xlim  = (-rges_x_lim, rges_x_lim)

ax_rges.set_xlim(rges_xlim)
ax_rges.axvline(0, color='#888888', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)
ax_rges.set_ylim(-0.5, N - 0.5)
ax_rges.invert_yaxis()
ax_rges.grid(axis='x', color=GRID_COL, linewidth=0.5, zorder=0)
ax_rges.spines[['top', 'right', 'left']].set_visible(False)
ax_rges.tick_params(left=False, labelsize=7)
ax_rges.set_title('RGES Score\n(Stouffer Z, BH-adj)', fontsize=13,
                   fontweight='bold', pad=6)
ax_rges.set_xlabel('Median Z-Score', fontsize=12)

for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    mz = row['median_z']
    pa = row['p_adj']
    if pd.isna(mz):
        # Draw a small grey marker to indicate missing data
        ax_rges.plot(0, i, '|', color='#DDDDDD', markersize=6, zorder=2)
        continue
    mz = float(mz)
    sig = pd.notna(pa) and float(pa) < 0.05
    c   = (C_RGES_IND if mz > 0 else C_RGES_REV) if sig else C_RGES_NS

    ax_rges.barh(i, mz, height=0.60,
                 color=c, alpha=0.85 if sig else 0.40, zorder=2)

    # Z-score value label
    offset = rges_xlim[1] * 0.025
    ha     = 'left' if mz >= 0 else 'right'
    x_txt  = mz + offset if mz >= 0 else mz - offset
    ax_rges.text(x_txt, i, f'{mz:.2f}',
                 va='center', ha=ha, fontsize=11, color=c, zorder=3)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 15 — ORIGINAL DISEASE NAME LABELS (right panel)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
for i, row in plot_df.iterrows():
    ax_orig.text(
        0.02, i,                           # data coords
        row['original'],
        ha='left', va='center',
        fontsize=13, color="#020000FF",
        style='italic',
        transform=ax_orig.get_yaxis_transform()   # x=axes, y=data
    )

ax_orig.set_title('Original Disease Name', fontsize=13,
                  fontweight='bold', pad=6)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 16 — LEGEND
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0],[0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor=C_UNEXP_SIG,
           markersize=7, label='Sema vs Unexposed — significant'),
    Line2D([0],[0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='none',
           markeredgecolor=C_UNEXP_NS, markeredgewidth=1.3, markersize=7,
           label='Sema vs Unexposed — not significant'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_RGES_IND, alpha=0.85,
                   label='RGES — induced (positive, p.adj<0.05)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_RGES_REV, alpha=0.85,
                   label='RGES — reversed (negative, p.adj<0.05)'),
    mpatches.Patch(color=C_RGES_NS,  alpha=0.55,
                   label='RGES — not significant'),
]
fig.legend(
    handles=legend_elements,
    loc='lower center', ncol=4,
    fontsize=13, frameon=False,
    bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005)
)

plt.savefig(OUTPUT_FILE, dpi=OUTPUT_DPI, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')

get_disease_folder <- function(filename) {

}



# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BLOCK 1: fgsea panels
# Outputs: p_fgsea_1, p_fgsea_2, p_fgsea_3
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

pair_overrides <- list(
  "Arrhythmogenic-Right-Ventricular-Dysplasia" = NULL,
  "Myotonic-Dystrophy"                         = "Chen_HF_Rat_S_Brain_0.1_4",

# Load reversal file
reversal <- read_csv(
  "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026_postAnnotationsBackup.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

diseases_of_interest <- names(pair_overrides)

results_filtered <- reversal %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("_S_",  Drug_Signature)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Z_Score_Median))

load_drug_ranked <- function(drug_sig_name) {
  df <- read_csv(file.path(drug_base, drug_sig_name), show_col_types = FALSE)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) & !is.na(df$Human_Symbol), ]
  df <- df[!duplicated(df$Human_Symbol), ]
  df <- df[order(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  setNames(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk, df$Human_Symbol)
}

load_disease_query <- function(disease_sig_name) {
  folder <- get_disease_folder(disease_sig_name)
  path   <- file.path(disease_base, folder, disease_sig_name)
  df     <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df     <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) &
               !is.na(df$identifier) & df$padj < 0.05, ]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(list(up = character(0), down = character(0)))
  symbols   <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = df$identifier,
                      column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                      multiVals = "first")
  df$symbol <- symbols[df$identifier]
  df        <- df[!is.na(df$symbol), ]
  list(
    up   = df$symbol[df$log2FoldChange > 0],
    down = df$symbol[df$log2FoldChange < 0]
  )
}

compute_running_es <- function(gene_set, ranked_stats) {
  n             <- length(ranked_stats)
  gene_pos      <- which(names(ranked_stats) %in% gene_set)
  if (length(gene_pos) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, n))
  hit            <- rep(0, n)
  hit[gene_pos]  <- 1
  stat_abs       <- abs(ranked_stats)
  hit_score      <- stat_abs * hit
  if (sum(hit_score) == 0) return(rep(0, n))
  cumsum(hit_score) / sum(hit_score) - cumsum(1 - hit) / sum(1 - hit)
}

make_fgsea_panel <- function(disease_name, z_score, query, ranked) {
  n      <- length(ranked)
  es_up  <- compute_running_es(query$up,   ranked)
  es_dn  <- compute_running_es(query$down, ranked)

      set.seed(42)
  res_up <- if (length(query$up) > 0)
    fgsea(list(UP   = query$up),   ranked, minSize = 1, maxSize = 5000,
          nPermSimple = 100000, scoreType = "neg") else NULL
  set.seed(42)
  res_dn <- if (length(query$down) > 0)
    fgsea(list(DOWN = query$down), ranked, minSize = 1, maxSize = 5000,
          nPermSimple = 100000, scoreType = "pos") else NULL

  fmt_stat <- function(res) if (!is.null(res))
    sprintf("NES=%.2f p=%s", round(res$NES[1], 2), signif(res$pval[1], 2)) else "n/a"

  df <- data.frame(x = seq_len(n))
  if (!all(is.na(es_up))) df$es_up <- es_up
  if (!all(is.na(es_dn))) df$es_dn <- es_dn

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60",
               linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed")

  if ("es_up" %in% names(df))
    p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = es_up, colour = "Disease UP"),
                       linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9)
  if ("es_dn" %in% names(df))
    p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = es_dn, colour = "Disease DOWN"),
                       linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9)

  p +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Disease UP" = "#D6604D", "Disease DOWN" = "#2166AC"),
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = gsub("-", " ", disease_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("UP: %s    DOWN: %s    Z = %.2f",
                         fmt_stat(res_up), fmt_stat(res_dn), z_score),
      x        = "Drug gene rank (high \u2192 low log\u2082FC)",
      y        = "Enrichment Score"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey35"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 6.5),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fgsea_plots <- list()

for (disease in diseases_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[fgsea] Processing: %s\n", disease))

  override  <- pair_overrides[[disease]]
  pool      <- results_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease)

  best_pair <- if (is.null(override)) {
    pool %>% dplyr::arrange(Z_Score_Median) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
  } else {
    pool %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(override, Drug_Signature, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
             dplyr::arrange(Z_Score_Median) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
  }

  if (nrow(best_pair) == 0) { cat("  No pair found — skipping\n"); next }
  cat(sprintf("  Pair: %s  |  Z = %.4f\n",
              best_pair$Drug_Signature, best_pair$Z_Score_Median))

  ranked <- load_drug_ranked(best_pair$Drug_Signature)
  query  <- load_disease_query(best_pair$Disease_Signature)
  cat(sprintf("  Query genes — UP: %d  DOWN: %d\n",
              length(query$up), length(query$down)))

  if (length(query$up) == 0 && length(query$down) == 0) {
    cat("  No DE genes — skipping\n"); next
  }

  fgsea_plots[[disease]] <- make_fgsea_panel(
    disease_name = disease,
    z_score      = best_pair$Z_Score_Median,
    query        = query,
    ranked       = ranked
  )
  cat("  Done.\n")
}

# ── 2a. Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

results_csv_path      <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/SecondaryDatasetReversalValidation/Reversal_Results/SecondaryDataset_Reversal_Scores.csv"
original_results_path <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026.csv"

# ── 2b. Load & filter to diseases of interest ─────────────────────────────────

diseases_of_interest <- c(
  "Arrhythmogenic-Right-Ventricular-Dysplasia",
  "Myotonic-Dystrophy",
  "Huntington-Disease"
)

cat("Loading reversal results...\n")
all_results <- read_csv(results_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Original disease count — kept as BH correction denominator
original_results    <- read_csv(original_results_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
n_original_diseases <- original_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Drug_Signature, "_S_|_s_"),
    !stringr::str_detect(Drug_Signature)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Disease_Name) %>%
  dplyr::n_distinct()
cat(sprintf("Original disease count (BH denominator): %d\n", n_original_diseases))

plot_data_raw <- all_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stringr::str_detect(Drug_Signature, "_S_|_s_"),
    !stringr::str_detect(Drug_Signature),
    Disease_Name %in% diseases_of_interest        # ← 3 diseases only
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig_type = ifelse(
      grepl("_original", Disease_Signature, ignore.case = TRUE),
      "DzSigDatabase", "Third Party Dataset"
    )
  )
cat(sprintf("Comparisons loaded: %d\n", nrow(plot_data_raw)))

# ── 2c. Stouffer stats + BH correction ───────────────────────────────────────

get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x          <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n          <- length(x)
  median_z   <- median(x)
  stouffer_z <- sum(x) / sqrt(n)
  p_val_raw  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(stouffer_z))
  c(median = median_z, n = n, stouffer_z = stouffer_z, p_val_raw = p_val_raw)
}

stats_df <- plot_data_raw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Disease_Name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)

n_our_diseases <- nrow(stats_df)
n_padding      <- max(0, n_original_diseases - n_our_diseases)
cat(sprintf("Our diseases: %d  |  BH padding: %d dummy p=1 values\n",
            n_our_diseases, n_padding))

padded_pvals       <- c(stats_df$p_val_raw, rep(1.0, n_padding))
adjusted_all       <- p.adjust(padded_pvals, method = "BH")
stats_df$p_val_adj <- adjusted_all[seq_len(n_our_diseases)]

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median > 0 ~  1,
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median < 0 ~ -1,
      TRUE                          ~  0
    ),
    dot_color = dplyr::case_when(
      sig ==  1 ~ "#C0392B",
      sig == -1 ~ "#2E86C1",
      TRUE      ~ "grey70"
    )
  )

cat("\nSummary stats:\n")
print(stats_df %>%
        dplyr::select(Disease_Name, n, median, stouffer_z, p_val_raw, p_val_adj, sig))

# ── 2d. Shared x limits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

jitter_colors <- c(
  "DzSigDatabase"      = "#E67E22",
  "Third Party Dataset" = "#8E44AD"
)

x_min <- min(c(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, stats_df$median), na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(c(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, stats_df$median), na.rm = TRUE)
if (x_min > 0) x_min <- -1
if (x_max < 0) x_max <-  1
span  <- x_max - x_min
if (span == 0) span <- 2
xlim  <- c(x_min - span * 0.05, x_max + span * 0.20)
cat(sprintf("Shared X limits: %.2f to %.2f\n", xlim[1], xlim[2]))

# ── 2e. Panel builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

make_reversal_panel <- function(disease) {

  dz_stats <- stats_df      %>% dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease)
  dz_raw   <- plot_data_raw %>% dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease)

  wrapped_label    <- stringr::str_wrap(gsub("-", " ", disease), width = 20)
  dz_stats$y_label <- wrapped_label
  dz_raw$y_label   <- wrapped_label

  ggplot(dz_stats, aes(x = median, y = y_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(
      data   = dz_raw,
      aes(x = Z_Score_Median, y = y_label, fill = sig_type),
      shape  = 21, color = "white", stroke = 0.2,
      height = 0.25, width = 0,
      alpha  = 0.80, size  = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = jitter_colors,
      name   = "Signature Type",
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = dot_color), size = 5) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x     = xlim[2] * 0.90,
      y     = 1,
      hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, color = "grey30",
      label = paste0("p.adj=", signif(dz_stats$p_val_adj, 2),
                     "  n=", dz_stats$n)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans  = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.5, base = 10),
      breaks = c(-10, -5, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 5, 10)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("-", " ", disease),
      x     = "Median Z-Score",
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7, lineheight = 0.8),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 6.5),
      legend.position    = "none",     # collected at assembly in Block 4
      plot.margin        = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── 2f. Build panels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

p_rev_1 <- make_reversal_panel("Arrhythmogenic-Right-Ventricular-Dysplasia")
p_rev_2 <- make_reversal_panel("Myotonic-Dystrophy")

library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(igraph)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BLOCK 3: Network panels
# Outputs: p_net_1, p_net_2, p_net_3
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── 3a. Paths & settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

prox_dir     <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Proximity"
n_vis        <- 10   # max drug / disease genes to show per plot
max_path     <- 3    # maximum path length between gene sets

diseases_of_interest <- c(
  "Arrhythmogenic-Right-Ventricular-Dysplasia",
  "Myotonic-Dystrophy",
  "Huntington-Disease"
)

# ── 3b. Load cached objects ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

cat("Loading STRING graph...\n")
string_graph <- readRDS(file.path(prox_dir, "string_graph.rds"))
cat(sprintf("  Nodes: %d  |  Edges: %d\n",
            igraph::vcount(string_graph), igraph::ecount(string_graph)))

cat("Loading ENSG → STRING map...\n")
ensg_to_string_map <- readRDS(file.path(prox_dir, "ensg_to_string_map_DE.rds"))
cat(sprintf("  Mappings: %d\n", length(ensg_to_string_map)))

cat("Loading DE gene sets...\n")
drug_gene_sets_de    <- readRDS(file.path(prox_dir, "drug_gene_sets_DE.rds"))
disease_gene_sets_de <- readRDS(file.path(prox_dir, "disease_gene_sets_DE.rds"))
cat(sprintf("  Drug sets: %d  |  Disease sets: %d\n",
            length(drug_gene_sets_de), length(disease_gene_sets_de)))

# ── 3c. Load proximity results ────────────────────────────────────────────────

prox_results <- read_csv(
  file.path(prox_dir, "Semaglutide_Proximity_DE_Results.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

prox_filtered <- prox_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("_S_", Drug_Signature)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!grepl(Drug_Signature)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Proximity_N10))

global_mean <- mean(prox_filtered$Proximity_N10, na.rm = TRUE)
global_sd   <- sd(prox_filtered$Proximity_N10,   na.rm = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("Global Proximity_N10 — mean: %.4f  SD: %.4f\n",
            global_mean, global_sd))

# ── 3d. Build STRING → symbol reverse map ────────────────────────────────────

cat("Building STRING → symbol reverse map...\n")
string_rev_df <- data.frame(
  STRING_id        = ensg_to_string_map,
  ENSG             = names(ensg_to_string_map),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
string_rev_df        <- string_rev_df[!duplicated(string_rev_df$STRING_id), ]
symbols_rev          <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                               keys      = string_rev_df$ENSG,
                               column    = "SYMBOL",
                               keytype   = "ENSEMBL",
                               multiVals = "first")
string_rev_df$symbol <- symbols_rev[string_rev_df$ENSG]
string_rev_df$label  <- ifelse(!is.na(string_rev_df$symbol),
                                string_rev_df$symbol,
                                string_rev_df$STRING_id)
string_to_symbol_map <- setNames(string_rev_df$label, string_rev_df$STRING_id)
cat(sprintf("  Reverse map built: %d entries\n", length(string_to_symbol_map)))

# ── 3e. Panel builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

make_network_panel <- function(disease_name, drug_sig,
                               drug_set, dis_set,
                               proximity_score, z_score_prox,
                               median_prox_disease, z_score_median_prox) {   # ← add this

  nodes    <- igraph::V(string_graph)$name
  drug_vis <- head(unique(intersect(drug_set, nodes)), n_vis)
  dis_vis  <- head(unique(intersect(dis_set,  nodes)), n_vis)

  if (length(drug_vis) == 0 || length(dis_vis) == 0) {
    cat("  Empty gene set after intersection — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  dist_mat    <- igraph::distances(string_graph, v = drug_vis, to = dis_vis)
  close_pairs <- which(dist_mat <= max_path, arr.ind = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  Close pairs (dist <= %d): %d\n", max_path, nrow(close_pairs)))

  if (nrow(close_pairs) == 0) {
    cat("  No close pairs — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  path_nodes <- c()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(close_pairs))) {
    p <- tryCatch(
      igraph::shortest_paths(
        string_graph,
        from   = drug_vis[close_pairs[k, 1]],
        to     = dis_vis [close_pairs[k, 2]],
        output = "vpath"
      )$vpath[[1]],
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(p) && length(p) > 0)
      path_nodes <- c(path_nodes, as.integer(p))
  }

  path_nodes <- unique(path_nodes[!is.na(path_nodes)])
  if (length(path_nodes) < 2) {
    cat("  Insufficient path nodes — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  subg <- igraph::induced_subgraph(string_graph, path_nodes)
  igraph::V(subg)$role <- "intermediate"
  igraph::V(subg)$role[igraph::V(subg)$name %in% drug_vis] <- "drug"
  igraph::V(subg)$role[igraph::V(subg)$name %in% dis_vis]  <- "disease"
  igraph::V(subg)$display_label <- ifelse(
    igraph::V(subg)$role != "intermediate",
    string_to_symbol_map[igraph::V(subg)$name],
    ""
  )
  cat(sprintf("  Subgraph: %d nodes, %d edges\n",
              igraph::vcount(subg), igraph::ecount(subg)))

  z_sign        <- ifelse(z_score_prox >= 0, "+", "")
  z_sign_median <- ifelse(z_score_median_prox >= 0, "+", "")
  z_label <- sprintf(
    "Proximity (this pair) = %.3f  (%s%.2f SD)\nMedian proximity (all pairs) = %.3f  (%s%.2f SD)",
    proximity_score,     z_sign,        z_score_prox,
    median_prox_disease, z_sign_median, z_score_median_prox
  )
  z_color <- ifelse(z_score_prox <= 0, "#2166AC", "#D6604D")

  set.seed(42)   # FR layout is stochastic — fix for reproducibility
  ggraph(subg, layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.4) +
    geom_node_point(aes(colour = role, shape = role, size = role)) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = display_label),
      repel        = TRUE,
      size         = 2.2,          # scaled for ~2.5" panel width
      max.overlaps = 30,
      fontface     = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(drug         = "#2166AC",
                 disease      = "#D6604D",
                 intermediate = "grey55"),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(drug = 17, disease = 19, intermediate = 19),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    scale_size_manual(
      values = c(drug = 3, disease = 3, intermediate = 1.4),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = gsub("-", " ", disease_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("Drug: %s  |  Nodes: %d  Edges: %d",
                         gsub("_DESeq2_results.csv", "", drug_sig),
                         igraph::vcount(subg), igraph::ecount(subg)),
      caption  = z_label,
      colour   = NULL, shape = NULL, size = NULL
    ) +
    theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",       # collected at assembly in Block 4
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey40"),
      plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold",
                                     colour = z_color, hjust = 0.5,
                                     margin = margin(t = 4)),
      plot.margin     = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── 3f. Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

network_plots <- list()

for (disease in diseases_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[network] Processing: %s\n", disease))

  best_pair <- prox_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease, !is.na(Proximity_N10)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Proximity_N10) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(best_pair) == 0) { cat("  No pair found — skipping\n"); next }

  prox_score   <- best_pair$Proximity_N10[1]
  z_score_prox <- (prox_score - global_mean) / global_sd
  median_prox_disease <- median(
    prox_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease) %>% dplyr::pull(Proximity_N10),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  z_score_median_prox <- (median_prox_disease - global_mean) / global_sd 
  drug_set     <- drug_gene_sets_de[[best_pair$Drug_Signature]]$N10
  dis_set      <- disease_gene_sets_de[[best_pair$Disease_Signature]]$N10

  cat(sprintf("  Pair: %s\n", best_pair$Drug_Signature))
  cat(sprintf("  Proximity_N10 = %.4f  |  Z = %.2f SD\n",
              prox_score, z_score_prox))
  cat(sprintf("  Drug genes: %d  |  Disease genes: %d\n",
              length(drug_set), length(dis_set)))

  if (length(drug_set) == 0 || length(dis_set) == 0) {
    cat("  Empty gene set — skipping\n"); next
  }

  network_plots[[disease]] <- make_network_panel(
    disease_name        = disease,
    drug_sig            = best_pair$Drug_Signature,
    drug_set            = drug_set,
    dis_set             = dis_set,
    proximity_score     = prox_score,
    z_score_prox        = z_score_prox,
    median_prox_disease = median_prox_disease,   # ← add this
    z_score_median_prox = z_score_median_prox   # ← add this
  )
  cat("  Done.\n")
}

# ── 3g. Named exports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

p_net_1 <- network_plots[["Arrhythmogenic-Right-Ventricular-Dysplasia"]]
p_net_2 <- network_plots[["Myotonic-Dystrophy"]]
p_net_3 <- network_plots[["Huntington-Disease"]]

# ── 3h. Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

print(p_net_1)
print(p_net_2)
print(p_net_3)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "PREVIEW_block3_network.png"),
  plot     = preview_net,

)

# ==============================================================================
# Figure 1B — Semaglutide Signature Landscape (FULL)
# Bubble plot: Tissue × Dosage/Duration, colored by % Sig. GOBP (0–20),
#              sized by Num. DE Genes, faceted by Species (Mouse | Rat)
# Two panels side-by-side: Treatment Dosage (left) + Treatment Duration (right)
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 0. PATHS
# ==============================================================================
BASE_DIR   <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"
META_FILE  <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")
DE_DIR     <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "DE_signatures_Standardized")
GOBP_DIR   <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "ReactomeGOBPgsea")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Figures")

if (!dir.exists(OUTPUT_DIR)) dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

PADJ_THRESH <- 0.05
JITTER_W    <- 0.25   # horizontal jitter
JITTER_H    <- 0.10   # vertical jitter (reduced)
ALPHA       <- 0.75   # bubble transparency
STROKE      <- 0.35   # outline thickness
GOBP_MAX    <- 20     # fixed colour scale ceiling
set.seed(42)

# ==============================================================================
# 1. LOAD METADATA — one row per signature key
# ==============================================================================
cat("=== Loading metadata ===\n")

raw_meta <- read_excel(META_FILE)

sig_meta <- raw_meta %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Key) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    Tissue       = dplyr::first(tissue),
    Species      = unique(species[Group_Type == "Case"])[1],
    Perturbation = unique(perturbation[Group_Type == "Case"])[1],
    Dosage       = unique(Dosage[Group_Type == "Case"])[1],
    Duration     = unique(Duration[Group_Type == "Case"])[1],
    .groups      = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Semaglutide", Perturbation, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Species      = str_to_title(Species),
    Tissue       = str_to_title(Tissue),
    Dosage_Num   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Dosage))),
    Duration_Num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(Duration))),
    Dosage_Label = case_when(
      is.na(Dosage) | as.character(Dosage) == "NA" ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ paste(as.character(Dosage), "mg/kg")
    ),
    Duration_Label = case_when(
      is.na(Duration) | as.character(Duration) == "NA" ~ "NA",
      TRUE ~ paste(as.character(Duration), "weeks")
    )
  )

cat(sprintf("  Signatures: %d  (Mouse: %d, Rat: %d)\n",
            nrow(sig_meta),
            sum(sig_meta$Species == "Mouse", na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(sig_meta$Species == "Rat",   na.rm = TRUE)))

# ==============================================================================
# 2. COUNT DE GENES PER SIGNATURE
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n=== Counting DE genes ===\n")

de_files <- list.files(DE_DIR, pattern = "_DESeq2_results\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
de_keys  <- str_remove(basename(de_files), "_DESeq2_results\\.csv$")

count_de <- function(path) {
  df <- tryCatch(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) return(0L)
  padj_col <- intersect(c("padj", "BH", "adj.P.Val"), names(df))[1]
  if (is.na(padj_col)) return(0L)
  sum(df[[padj_col]] < PADJ_THRESH, na.rm = TRUE)
}

de_counts <- tibble(
  Key    = de_keys,
  Num_DE = map_int(de_files, count_de)
) %>%
  filter(Key %in% sig_meta$Key)

cat(sprintf("  Matched: %d\n", nrow(de_counts)))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. COUNT % SIGNIFICANT GOBP PATHWAYS PER SIGNATURE
#    Files: *_GSEA_Module_results.csv; GOBP pathways start with "GOBP_"
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n=== Counting % significant GOBP pathways ===\n")

module_files <- list.files(GOBP_DIR, pattern = "_GSEA_Module_results\\.csv$",
                            full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
module_keys  <- str_remove(basename(module_files), "_GSEA_Module_results\\.csv$")

count_pct_gobp <- function(path) {
  df <- tryCatch(read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NA_real_)
  if (!all(c("pathway", "padj") %in% names(df))) return(NA_real_)
  gobp    <- df %>% filter(str_starts(pathway, "GOBP_"))
  n_total <- sum(!is.na(gobp$padj))
  if (n_total == 0) return(NA_real_)
  n_sig <- sum(gobp$padj < PADJ_THRESH, na.rm = TRUE)
  round(100 * n_sig / n_total, 2)
}

gobp_counts <- tibble(
  Key          = module_keys,
  Pct_Sig_GOBP = map_dbl(module_files, count_pct_gobp)
) %>%
  filter(Key %in% sig_meta$Key)

cat(sprintf("  Matched: %d\n", nrow(gobp_counts)))

# ==============================================================================
# 4. ASSEMBLE PLOT DATA
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n=== Assembling plot data ===\n")

plot_data <- sig_meta %>%
  left_join(de_counts,   by = "Key") %>%
  left_join(gobp_counts, by = "Key") %>%
  mutate(
    Num_DE        = replace_na(Num_DE, 0L),
    Num_DE_capped = pmin(Num_DE, 2000),
    # Clamp GOBP colour at ceiling so values > 20 still render as max colour
    Pct_Sig_GOBP_clamped = pmin(Pct_Sig_GOBP, GOBP_MAX),
    # Ordered factors: numeric ascending, NA at top
    Dosage_fct   = factor(Dosage_Label,
                          levels = c(sort(unique(Dosage_Label[Dosage_Label != "NA"])), "NA")),
    Duration_fct = factor(Duration_Label,
                          levels = c(sort(unique(Duration_Label[Duration_Label != "NA"])), "NA"))
  )

cat(sprintf("  Rows: %d\n", nrow(plot_data)))

# ==============================================================================
# 5. SHARED THEME & SCALES
# ==============================================================================

size_breaks <- c(0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)
size_labels <- c("0", "500", "1000", "1500", "2000+")

base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 7, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    text              = element_text(size = 7, family = "sans"),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "grey70"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7, family = "sans"),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7, family = "sans"),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans"),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 10, family = "sans"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", family = "sans"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "lines"),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, hjust = 0, family = "sans"),
    plot.margin       = margin(6, 6, 2, 6)
  )

# shape = 21 gives filled circles with a separate outline colour
dot_aes  <- list(shape = 21, stroke = STROKE, color = "grey30", alpha = ALPHA)

fill_scale <- scale_fill_viridis_c(
  option   = "plasma",
  limits   = c(0, GOBP_MAX),
  name     = "% Sig.\nGOBP",
  oob      = squish,       # values above 20 squeezed to max colour
  na.value = "grey80",
  breaks   = c(0, 10, 20),
  labels   = c("0", "10", "20")
)

size_scale <- scale_size_continuous(
  range  = c(1, 10),
  limits = c(0, 2000),
  breaks = size_breaks,
  labels = size_labels,
  name   = "Num. DE Genes"
)

shared_guides <- guides(
  fill = guide_colorbar(
    title          = "% Sig.\nGOBP",
    barwidth       = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    barheight      = unit(3,   "cm"),
    title.position = "top"
  ),
  size = guide_legend(
    title          = "Num. DE Genes",
    title.position = "top",
    override.aes   = list(fill = "grey50", color = "grey30", shape = 21)
  )
)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. PANEL A — TREATMENT DOSAGE
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n=== Building Treatment Dosage panel ===\n")

p_dosage <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Tissue, y = Dosage_fct,
      fill = Pct_Sig_GOBP_clamped, size = Num_DE_capped)
) +
  do.call(geom_jitter, c(list(width = JITTER_W, height = JITTER_H), dot_aes)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Species), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  fill_scale +
  size_scale +
  shared_guides +
  labs(title = "Treatment Dosage", x = NULL, y = "Dosage") +
  base_theme

# =======================================================x=======================
# 7. PANEL B — TREATMENT DURATION  (legend suppressed — shown on left panel)
# ==============================================================================
cat("=== Building Treatment Duration panel ===\n")

p_duration <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = Tissue, y = Duration_fct,
      fill = Pct_Sig_GOBP_clamped, size = Num_DE_capped)
) +
  do.call(geom_jitter, c(list(width = JITTER_W, height = JITTER_H), dot_aes)) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Species), scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  fill_scale +
  size_scale +
  labs(title = "Treatment Duration", x = NULL, y = "Duration") +
  base_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ==============================================================================
# 8. COMBINE SIDE-BY-SIDE & SAVE AS PDF
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n=== Saving figure ===\n")

combined <- p_dosage | p_duration

out_path <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure1B_Semaglutide_Landscape_FULL.pdf")

ggsave(
  out_path,
  combined,
  width  = 18,
  height = 5.25,   # 25% shorter than original 7 in
  device = "pdf"
)

cat(sprintf("Saved: %s\n", out_path))
cat("Done.\n")









#SUPPLEMENTARY VERSION


library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(gridExtra)
library(readxl)

# ==========================================
# 1. SETUP PATHS
# ==========================================
base_dir <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide"

# Metadata
meta_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")

# Signature Files (for DE counts)
sig_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DE_signatures_Standardized")

# GSEA Pathways Directory
gsea_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "ReactomeGOBPgsea")

# Pathway filter (Set to "GOBP" or "reactome")
pathway_filter <- "GOBP"

# Output Directory — Supplementary
out_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "Figures/Supplement")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# ==========================================
# 2. LOAD & PREPARE DATA
# ==========================================
meta <- read_excel(meta_path)

# Filter for Semaglutide & Unique Signatures
plot_data <- meta %>%
  filter(perturbation == "Semaglutide") %>%
  distinct(Key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Key, species, tissue, Dosage, Duration)

# Initialize Columns
plot_data$DE_Count          <- NA
plot_data$Pct_Sig_Pathways  <- NA

message("Starting data integration...")

# ==========================================
# 3. MAIN LOOP: CALCULATE METRICS
# ==========================================
for (i in 1:nrow(plot_data)) {

  curr_key     <- plot_data$Key[i]
  curr_species <- plot_data$species[i]
  curr_tissue  <- plot_data$tissue[i]

  # --- A. DE GENE COUNTS ---
  sig_path <- file.path(sig_dir, paste0(curr_key, "_DESeq2_results.csv"))

  if (file.exists(sig_path)) {
    sig_df <- read.csv(sig_path)
    plot_data$DE_Count[i] <- sum(
      sig_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(sig_df$log2FoldChange) > 0.58,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    warning(paste("DE File missing for:", curr_key))
    plot_data$DE_Count[i] <- 0
  }

  # --- B. PATHWAY ENRICHMENT ---
  gsea_path <- file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(curr_key, "_GSEA_Module_results.csv"))

  if (file.exists(gsea_path)) {
    gsea_df  <- read.csv(gsea_path)
    gsea_sub <- gsea_df[grepl(pathway_filter, gsea_df$pathway, ignore.case = TRUE), ]

    if (nrow(gsea_sub) > 0) {
      sig_count <- sum(gsea_sub$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
      plot_data$Pct_Sig_Pathways[i] <- (sig_count / nrow(gsea_sub)) * 100
    } else {
      warning(paste("No", pathway_filter, "pathways found for:", curr_key))
      plot_data$Pct_Sig_Pathways[i] <- 0
    }
  } else {
    warning(paste("GSEA file missing for:", curr_key))
    plot_data$Pct_Sig_Pathways[i] <- NA
  }
}

# ==========================================
# 4. SCALING (continuous numeric axes)
# ==========================================

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    Dosage_Num   = as.numeric(str_extract(Dosage,   "[0-9\\.]+")),
    Duration_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(Duration, "[0-9\\.]+")),
    # Cap DE_Count at 1000 for the size scale — raw data unchanged
    DE_Count_Plot = pmin(DE_Count, 1000, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Evenly spaced breaks across the real range, labeled every other tick.
# pretty() gives clean break positions; we keep ticks at all of them but
# blank out every second label so labels appear ~every two ticks.
make_axis_breaks <- function(x, n = 8) {
  brks <- pretty(range(x, na.rm = TRUE), n = n)
  labs <- as.character(brks)
  labs[seq(2, length(labs), by = 2)] <- ""   # blank every other label
  list(breaks = brks, labels = labs)
}

dosage_axis   <- make_axis_breaks(plot_data$Dosage_Num)
duration_axis <- make_axis_breaks(plot_data$Duration_Num)

# Scale vertical jitter to each axis's real range so it stays
# visually comparable to the old categorical jitter (~0.15 of a step).
# We use a small fraction of the total span.
dosage_span   <- diff(range(plot_data$Dosage_Num,   na.rm = TRUE))
duration_span <- diff(range(plot_data$Duration_Num, na.rm = TRUE))

dosage_jitter_h   <- dosage_span   * 0.02
duration_jitter_h <- duration_span * 0.02

# ==========================================
# 5. GENERATE PLOTS
# ==========================================

# Revised size scale: 0, 500, >1000
size_breaks <- c(0, 500, 1000)
size_labels <- c("0", "500", ">1,000")

common_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "gray92"),
    legend.position   = "right",
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# --- PLOT 1: DOSAGE (Y-Axis, continuous) ---
p_dosage <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Dosage_Num)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(size = DE_Count_Plot, fill = Pct_Sig_Pathways),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5,
    width = 0.3, height = dosage_jitter_h, alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_grid(~species, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = dosage_axis$breaks,
    labels = dosage_axis$labels
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range   = c(2, 8),
    name    = "Num. DE Genes",
    limits  = c(0, 1000),
    breaks  = size_breaks,
    labels  = size_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option   = "plasma",
    name     = paste("% Sig.\n", pathway_filter),
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(y = "Dosage", x = NULL, title = "Treatment Dosage") +
  common_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
  )

# --- PLOT 2: DURATION (Y-Axis, continuous, ordered by weeks) ---
p_duration <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = tissue, y = Duration_Num)) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(size = DE_Count_Plot, fill = Pct_Sig_Pathways),
    shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5,
    width = 0.3, height = duration_jitter_h, alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  facet_grid(~species, scales = "free_x", space = "free") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = duration_axis$breaks,
    labels = duration_axis$labels
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range   = c(2, 8),
    name    = "Num. DE Genes",
    limits  = c(0, 1000),
    breaks  = size_breaks,
    labels  = size_labels
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option    = "plasma",
    name      = paste("% Sig.\n", pathway_filter),
    direction = -1,
    na.value  = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(y = "Duration (weeks)", x = "Tissue", title = "Treatment Duration") +
  common_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black")
  )

# ==========================================
# 6. COMBINE & SAVE
# ==========================================
final_figure <- arrangeGrob(
  p_dosage, p_duration,
  ncol    = 1,
  heights = c(1, 1.2)   # bottom panel slightly taller for x-axis labels
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "FigureS1_Semaglutide_Landscape.pdf"),
  plot     = final_figure,
  device   = "pdf",
  width    = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300
)

message("Supplementary Figure S1 saved successfully!")

library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)

sig_dir <- ('OneDrive - Michigan State University/BinChenLab/1_Research/Disease Signature/dz_sig/signatures_new/')
length(list.files(sig_dir))

process_disease <- function(disease_path) {
  files <- list.files(disease_path, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  disease_name <- basename(disease_path)
  sig_list <- lapply(files, fread)
  sig_list <- lapply(sig_list, function(df) {df[, .(identifier, log2FoldChange)]})
  merged <- rbindlist(sig_list)

  avg_sig <- merged[, .(log2FoldChange = mean(log2FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE)), by = identifier]
  setnames(avg_sig, "log2FoldChange", disease_name)
  return(avg_sig)
}
disease_dirs <- list.dirs(sig_dir, recursive = FALSE)
disease_signatures <- lapply(disease_dirs, process_disease)

signature_matrix <- reduce(disease_signatures, function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "identifier", all = FALSE))
sig_mat <- as.data.frame(signature_matrix)
rownames(sig_mat) <- sig_mat$identifier
sig_mat$identifier <- NULL

cor_mat <- cor(sig_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
png(filename = "Desktop/disease_signature_correlation.png", width = 10, height = 7, units = "in", res = 600)
pheatmap(cor_mat, show_rownames = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE, clustering_distance_rows = "correlation", clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
         clustering_method = "complete", color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "darkred"))(221), breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 202))
dev.off()

agg_df$pathway_label <- factor(agg_df$pathway_label, levels = unique(label_levels))

# ==============================================================================
# SUMMARY FIGURE — cross-drug difference-of-differences, all comparable cells
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Reuses level2_difference_of_differences.csv.
# Single axis = every "tissue: cell type" that is present in BOTH arms,
# grouped into tissue blocks. Two renderings (pick one for the paper):
#   (A) Lollipop  : x = DoD, color = DoD magnitude, asterisk = significance
#   (B) Heatmap   : single column, fill = DoD, asterisk = significance
# Avoids the empty tissue x cell-type grid by collapsing both onto one axis.
# ==============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr); library(forcats)
})

ROOT <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Deconvolution_Comparison"

CONFIG <- list(
  dod_csv = file.path(ROOT, "comparison", "level2_difference_of_differences.csv"),
  out_dir = file.path(ROOT, "comparison", "summary_figure")
)
dir.create(CONFIG$out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- X-axis (cell-type) label appearance knobs --------------------------------
XLAB_SIZE  <- 17   # cell-type label font size (was 15); +2 for legibility
XLAB_ANGLE <- 60   # increased toward vertical; steeper slant packs labels tighter
XLAB_WRAP  <- 0    # 0 = no wrapping (labels run at full length on the slant)

# --- Load + prepare -----------------------------------------------------------
dod <- read_csv(CONFIG$dod_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

sig_stars <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*", ""))))
}

d <- dod %>%
  mutate(
    star  = sig_stars(p_value),
    label = paste0(tissue, ": ", Cell_Type)
  ) %>%
  # Order: tissue block (alphabetical), and within tissue by DoD so each block
  # reads from most-negative to most-positive.
  arrange(tissue, diff_of_diff) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number())

# Build an ordered factor for the y-axis preserving tissue grouping + within sort
d$label <- factor(d$label, levels = d$label[order(d$tissue, d$diff_of_diff)])

# Symmetric color limits so the midpoint (0) is true white
lim <- max(abs(d$diff_of_diff), na.rm = TRUE)

# Asterisk placement: sit a fixed gap (in data units) beyond each point, on the
# far side from zero — above positive lollipops, below negative ones. Scaling to
# the range keeps the gap consistent as point size changes.
star_gap <- lim * 0.22
d <- d %>%
  mutate(
    star_y = diff_of_diff + ifelse(diff_of_diff >= 0, star_gap, -star_gap)
  )

# Tissue band positions (for subtle background shading / separators)
tissue_levels <- d %>% distinct(tissue) %>% arrange(tissue) %>% pull(tissue)

n_rows    <- nrow(d)
n_tissue  <- length(tissue_levels)
# Width scales with total cell types (they sit along x now); height is fixed-ish.
# Extra constant width gives the slanted leftmost labels room before the panel.
fig_w_lolli <- max(8, 0.34 * n_rows + 4)
# Diagonal (45) labels run below-left and need bottom room; vertical (90) needs more.
fig_h_lolli <- if (XLAB_ANGLE == 90) 9 else 8.5

# For a horizontal layout the x-axis is cell type (within tissue), y is the DoD.
# Order cell types within each tissue by DoD so each column reads low -> high.
d_h <- d %>%
  arrange(tissue, diff_of_diff) %>%
  mutate(ct_in_tissue = factor(Cell_Type, levels = unique(Cell_Type)))
# Note: facet by tissue means the within-facet x ordering uses the per-tissue
# subset; reorder_within avoids cross-tissue collisions of identical names.
d_h <- d_h %>%
  group_by(tissue) %>%
  mutate(ct_ord = factor(Cell_Type,
                         levels = Cell_Type[order(diff_of_diff)])) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # optionally wrap long cell-type names (XLAB_WRAP = 0 disables wrapping)
  { if (XLAB_WRAP > 0)
      mutate(., ct_ord = factor(
        str_wrap(as.character(ct_ord), width = XLAB_WRAP),
        levels = str_wrap(levels(ct_ord), width = XLAB_WRAP)
      ))
    else . }

# When labels are vertical (90 deg) they should be centered on the tick;
# when diagonal (45 deg) they read better right-justified.
xlab_hjust <- if (XLAB_ANGLE == 90) 1   else 1
xlab_vjust <- if (XLAB_ANGLE == 90) 0.5 else 1

# ==============================================================================
# (A) LOLLIPOP — HORIZONTAL: tissues as side-by-side column panels
# ==============================================================================
pA <- ggplot(d_h, aes(x = ct_ord, y = diff_of_diff)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey55") +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = ct_ord, y = 0, yend = diff_of_diff),
               color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = diff_of_diff), shape = 21, size = 6.5, stroke = 0.4,
             color = "grey25") +
  geom_text(aes(y = star_y, label = star),
            hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 5, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2471A3", mid = "white", high = "#C0392B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
                       name = expression(Delta*Delta)) +
  # headroom so asterisks offset beyond the tallest points don't clip
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.16)) +
  # tissues become columns; each shows only its own cell types
  facet_grid(. ~ tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Semaglutide vs SGLT2i: differential cell-type response",
    subtitle = expression(
      "Point = mean("*Delta*" Sema) \u2212 mean("*Delta*" SGLT2i) across signatures;  "*
      "blue = lower under Sema, red = lower under SGLT2i;  * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001"),
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(Delta*Delta*" enrichment (Sema effect \u2212 SGLT2i effect)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = XLAB_SIZE,
                               angle = XLAB_ANGLE, hjust = xlab_hjust,
                               vjust = xlab_vjust, lineheight = 0.85),
    axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.title  = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.text   = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.key.height = unit(1.4, "cm"),
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 6, b = 30, l = 30),
    panel.spacing = unit(6, "pt")
  )
x
ggsave(file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "summary_lollipop.png"),
       pA, width = fig_w_lolli, height = fig_h_lolli, dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
ggsave(file.path(CONFIG$out_dir, "summary_lollipop.pdf"),

# ==============================================================================
# (B) SINGLE-COLUMN HEATMAP  (kept vertical; lollipop is the chosen figure)
# ==============================================================================
fig_h <- max(5, 0.30 * n_rows + 1.5)
pB <- ggplot(d, aes(x = 1, y = label, fill = diff_of_diff)) +

    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +

# =============================================================================
# Standalone Sample Size Bar Chart — EHR Diseases
# =============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(cowplot)
})
# =============================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
sample_size_path <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/EHRstuff/Sample_Size/Sample_Size_Individual_Disease_Whole_MSDWlatest.csv"
output_plot_dir  <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Figures/Supplement"
if (!dir.exists(output_plot_dir)) dir.create(output_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# --- Disease-label appearance knobs ------------------------------------------
YLAB_SIZE   <- 11   # disease-name font size (was 7)
VALUE_SIZE  <- 3.5  # bar value-label size in mm (was 2.5); ~10pt
FIG_WIDTH   <- 12   # inches; wider gives the bunched sqrt-scale x-ticks room

# =============================================================================
# 2. LOAD DATA
# =============================================================================
cat("Loading sample size data...\n")
ss_raw <- read_csv(sample_size_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
cat(paste("Diseases loaded:", nrow(ss_raw), "\n"))
cat(paste("Columns found:", paste(colnames(ss_raw), collapse = ", "), "\n"))
# =============================================================================
# 3. PREPARE & SORT
# =============================================================================
plot_df <- ss_raw %>%
  select(Disease_Name = Original_Disease_Name,
         Sample_Size  = SAMPLE_SIZE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Sample_Size), Sample_Size > 0) %>%
  arrange(Sample_Size) %>%
  mutate(Disease_Name = factor(Disease_Name, levels = Disease_Name))
cat(paste("Diseases to plot:", nrow(plot_df), "\n"))

# Adaptive x-axis breaks/limit from the data max. On a sqrt scale the high ticks
# crowd, so we choose round breaks; modest headroom keeps ticks spread while
# labels that would overflow are flipped inside the bar (handled per-row below).
max_n   <- max(plot_df$Sample_Size)
x_limit <- max_n * 1.18
x_breaks <- c(1e4, 1e5, 1e6)
if (max_n > 2.5e6) x_breaks <- c(x_breaks, 3e6)
x_breaks <- x_breaks[x_breaks <= max_n]   # drop breaks beyond the data

# Per-row label placement: bars whose end sits in the right ~22% of the axis get
# their value label placed INSIDE (right-justified, white) so it can't clip;
# everyone else gets it OUTSIDE (left-justified, grey) as before.
inside_threshold <- (sqrt(x_limit) * 0.78)^2   # back to data units on sqrt scale
plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  mutate(
    lab        = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())(Sample_Size),
    lab_inside = Sample_Size >= inside_threshold
  )


# =============================================================================
# 4. BUILD PLOT
# =============================================================================
# Split into two columns for readability
total   <- nrow(plot_df)
halfway <- ceiling(total / 2)
left_data  <- plot_df[1:halfway, ]
right_data <- plot_df[(halfway + 1):total, ]
make_bar_half <- function(data) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = Sample_Size, y = Disease_Name)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#5D6D7E", width = 0.7) +
    # labels for shorter bars: outside the bar end, grey
    geom_text(
      data    = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, !lab_inside),
      aes(label = lab),
      hjust   = -0.15, size = VALUE_SIZE, color = "grey30"
    ) +
    # labels for the longest bars: inside the bar end, white (never clips)
    geom_text(
      data    = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, lab_inside),
      aes(label = lab),
      hjust   = 1.15, size = VALUE_SIZE, color = "white"
    ) +
    scale_x_sqrt(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      breaks = x_breaks,
      expand = c(0.0, 0),
      limits = c(0, x_limit)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Sample Size (N, sqrt scale)", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = YLAB_SIZE),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 10)
    )
}
p_left  <- make_bar_half(left_data)
p_right <- make_bar_half(right_data)
final_plot <- plot_grid(p_left, p_right, ncol = 2, align = "h", axis = "tb")
# Add overall title
titled_plot <- plot_grid(
  ggdraw() +
    draw_label("EHR Disease Sample Sizes", fontface = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
          plot.margin     = margin(6, 0, 6, 0)),
  final_plot,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.04, 1)
)
# =============================================================================
# 5. SAVE
# =============================================================================
plot_height <- 3 + halfway * 0.20
outfile <- file.path(output_plot_dir, "Sample_Size_Bar_Chart.png")
ggsave(outfile, titled_plot,
       width     = FIG_WIDTH,
       height    = plot_height,
       limitsize = FALSE,
       bg        = "white",
       dpi       = 150)
cat(paste("\nSaved:", outfile, "\n"))
cat("Done.\n")

# ==============================================================================
# Forest Plot: Aducanumab vs Semaglutide vs Memantine, reversal of Alzheimer's
# disease signatures. All three drugs displayed.
#
# Color scheme = SIGNIFICANCE, applied ONLY to the aggregate (Stouffer median)
# point per (Disease_Name x Drug):
#   - Significant (BH-adjusted Stouffer p < 0.05) -> dodgerblue3
#   - Not significant                              -> grey
# The individual raw per-signature comparisons (jittered points underneath)
# are always a fixed neutral grey, regardless of the aggregate's significance -
# significance is a property of the aggregate, not each individual comparison.
# Drug identity is carried by SHAPE throughout.
# ==============================================================================

chenlab_root    <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab"
full_survey_dir <- file.path(chenlab_root, "semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide")
aduc_base_dir   <- file.path(full_survey_dir, "Aducunamab_Control")
memantine_base_dir <- file.path(aduc_base_dir, "Memantine")

sema_results_csv <- file.path(full_survey_dir, "Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026.csv")
sema_meta_path   <- file.path(full_survey_dir, "Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx")
aduc_results_csv <- file.path(aduc_base_dir, "Reversal_Signatures/Aducanumab_Reversal_Scores.csv")
mem_results_csv  <- file.path(memantine_base_dir, "Reversal_Signatures/Memantine_Reversal_Scores.csv")

output_plot_dir <- file.path(aduc_base_dir, "Comparison_Plots")
if (!dir.exists(output_plot_dir)) dir.create(output_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

min_signatures <- 1
SIG_COLOR   <- "dodgerblue3"
NONSIG_COLOR <- "grey70"

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. LOAD + FILTER SEMAGLUTIDE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Loading Semaglutide results...\n")
sema_raw  <- read_csv(sema_results_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
sema_meta <- read_excel(sema_meta_path)

sema_merged <- sema_raw %>%
