sema_filtered <- sema_merged %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Key, "_S_") | str_detect(Key, "_s_") |
    (if ("perturbation" %in% names(.)) str_detect(perturbation, regex("Semaglutide", ignore_case = TRUE)) else FALSE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Key)) %>%
  mutate(Drug = "Semaglutide")

cat(sprintf("   -> %d Semaglutide signature rows retained.\n", nrow(sema_filtered)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. LOAD ADUCANUMAB - loaded ONLY so the BH correction runs across the true
# family of 3 drugs. Dropped from the plot itself further down, AFTER
# significance is computed - never before, or the correction batch would be
# wrong again.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Loading Aducanumab results (for correction family only - not displayed)...\n")
aduc_raw <- read_csv(aduc_results_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

aduc_filtered <- aduc_raw %>%
  mutate(Key = str_remove(Drug_Signature, "_DESeq2_results.csv")) %>%
  distinct(Key, Disease_Signature, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Drug = "Aducanumab")

cat(sprintf("   -> %d Aducanumab signature rows retained.\n", nrow(aduc_filtered)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. LOAD MEMANTINE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("Loading Memantine results...\n")
mem_raw <- read_csv(mem_results_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

mem_filtered <- mem_raw %>%
  mutate(Key = str_remove(Drug_Signature, "_DESeq2_results.csv")) %>%
  distinct(Key, Disease_Signature, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Drug = "Memantine")

cat(sprintf("   -> %d Memantine signature rows retained.\n", nrow(mem_filtered)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. COMBINE + FILTER TO ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE ONLY
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
common_cols <- c("Key", "Drug", "Disease_Signature", "Disease_Name", "Disease_Tissue", "Z_Score_Median")

combined <- bind_rows(
  sema_filtered %>% dplyr::select(all_of(common_cols)),
  aduc_filtered %>% dplyr::select(all_of(common_cols)),
  mem_filtered  %>% dplyr::select(all_of(common_cols))
)

plot_data_raw <- combined %>%
  filter(str_detect(Disease_Name, regex("Alzheimer", ignore_case = TRUE)))

cat(sprintf("Alzheimer's signature rows - Semaglutide: %d | Aducanumab: %d | Memantine: %d\n",
            sum(plot_data_raw$Drug == "Semaglutide"),
            sum(plot_data_raw$Drug == "Aducanumab"),
            sum(plot_data_raw$Drug == "Memantine")))

if (nrow(plot_data_raw) == 0) {
  stop("No rows matched 'Alzheimer' in Disease_Name for either drug - check spelling/naming in the disease database.")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. STOUFFER STATS PER (Disease_Name x Drug), BH-adjusted across all THREE
# drugs, then Aducanumab is dropped for display only
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  median_z <- median(x)
  stouffer_z_score <- sum(x) / sqrt(n)
  p_val_raw <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(stouffer_z_score))
  c(median = median_z, n = n, stouffer_z = stouffer_z_score, p_val_raw = p_val_raw)
}

stats_df_all3 <- plot_data_raw %>%
  group_by(Disease_Name, Drug) %>%
  summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest_wider(stats) %>%
  filter(n >= min_signatures) %>%
  mutate(
    p_val_adj = p.adjust(p_val_raw, method = "BH"),  # corrected across all 3 drugs
    is_sig = p_val_adj < 0.05,
    dot_color = if_else(is_sig, SIG_COLOR, NONSIG_COLOR)
  )

cat("\n--- Full 3-drug correction family (all three will be displayed) ---\n")
print(stats_df_all3 %>% dplyr::select(Disease_Name, Drug, median, n, stouffer_z, p_val_adj, is_sig))

stats_df <- stats_df_all3

cat(sprintf("\nRows to plot (Disease x Drug combinations, all 3 drugs): %d\n", nrow(stats_df)))
print(stats_df %>% dplyr::select(Disease_Name, Drug, median, n, stouffer_z, p_val_adj, is_sig))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. PLOT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
disease_order <- stats_df %>%
  group_by(Disease_Name) %>%
  summarize(overall_mean = mean(median), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(overall_mean) %>%
  pull(Disease_Name)

stats_df$Disease_Name <- factor(stats_df$Disease_Name, levels = disease_order)
plot_data_raw$Disease_Name <- factor(plot_data_raw$Disease_Name, levels = disease_order)

p <- ggplot(stats_df, aes(x = median, y = Disease_Name)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_jitter(
    data = plot_data_raw,
    aes(x = Z_Score_Median, y = Disease_Name, shape = Drug, group = Drug),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.height = 0.12, dodge.width = 0.7),
    color = "grey55", alpha = 0.35, size = 1.1
  ) +

  ) +

  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Aducanumab" = 16, "Memantine" = 15, "Semaglutide" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "Reversal of Alzheimer's Disease Signatures",
    subtitle = "Blue (dodgerblue3) = significant AGGREGATE only | Grey = not significant | individual comparisons always shown grey",
    x = "Reversal Z-Score (Median)",
    y = NULL,
    shape = "Drug"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey95"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

out_file <- file.path(output_plot_dir, "Alzheimers_AllThreeDrugs_ForestPlot.png")
n_diseases <- length(disease_order)
plot_height <- max(3, 1.5 + 0.4 * n_diseases)

# =============================================================================
# Forest Plot — Stouffer's Method, Panels by Disease Tissue
# =============================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(readxl)
  library(cowplot)
})

# =============================================================================
# 1. CONFIGURATION
# =============================================================================
results_csv_path <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Reversal2.4.2026Signatures/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026.csv"
meta_path        <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Mouse_Signature_Metadata_Formatted.xlsx"
output_plot_dir  <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/Figures/Supplement"

min_signatures <- 1

# --- Disease-name (y-axis) label appearance knobs ----------------------------
YLAB_SIZE <- 12   # disease-name font size (was 7); compounds with narrower width
# YLAB_WRAP: currently unused — wrapping disabled; names render at full length and
# the figure is widened instead (see FIG_WIDTH_IN near ggsave).

if (!dir.exists(output_plot_dir)) dir.create(output_plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# =============================================================================
# 2. LOAD & CLEAN
# =============================================================================
cat("Loading data...\n")
all_results <- read_csv(results_csv_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
meta        <- read_excel(meta_path)

merged_results <- all_results %>%
  mutate(Key = str_remove(Drug_Signature, "_DESeq2_results.csv")) %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "Key") %>%
  distinct(Key, Disease_Signature, .keep_all = TRUE)


plot_data_raw <- merged_results %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(Key, "_S_") | str_detect(Key, "_s_") |
    (if ("perturbation" %in% names(.)) str_detect(perturbation, regex("Semaglutide", ignore_case = TRUE)) else FALSE)
  ) 

cat(paste("Remaining Signatures:", nrow(plot_data_raw), "\n"))

# =============================================================================
# 3. COLLAPSE BRAIN SUBREGIONS
# =============================================================================
plot_data_raw <- plot_data_raw %>%
  mutate(Disease_Tissue = ifelse(grepl("brain", Disease_Tissue, ignore.case = TRUE),
                                 "Brain", Disease_Tissue))

# =============================================================================
# 4. CALCULATE STATS
# =============================================================================
cat("Calculating Stouffer statistics and adjusting P-values...\n")

get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  median_z   <- median(x)
  stouffer_z <- sum(x) / sqrt(n)
  p_val_raw  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(stouffer_z))
  c(median = median_z, n = n, stouffer_z = stouffer_z, p_val_raw = p_val_raw)
}

stats_df <- plot_data_raw %>%
  group_by(Disease_Name, Disease_Tissue) %>%
  summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  unnest_wider(stats) %>%
  filter(n >= min_signatures) %>%
  mutate(
    p_val_adj = p.adjust(p_val_raw, method = "BH"),
    sig = case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median > 0 ~  1,
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median < 0 ~ -1,
      TRUE                           ~  0
    ),
    bar_color = case_when(
      sig ==  1 ~ "#C0392B",
      sig == -1 ~ "#2E86C1",
      TRUE      ~ "grey70"
    )
  )

cat(paste("Total diseases to plot:", nrow(stats_df), "\n"))
cat(paste("Tissues found:", paste(sort(unique(stats_df$Disease_Tissue)), collapse = ", "), "\n"))

# =============================================================================
# 5. GLOBAL X-AXIS LIMITS
# =============================================================================
# Base limits on the summary medians (always shown as solid points) plus a
# modest reach into the raw cloud, rather than the full raw range — a few
# extreme raw outliers otherwise stretch every panel wide and shrink the text.
raw_lo <- quantile(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
raw_hi <- quantile(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

global_min <- min(min(stats_df$median, na.rm = TRUE), raw_lo)
global_max <- max(max(stats_df$median, na.rm = TRUE), raw_hi)

if (global_min > 0) global_min <- -1
if (global_max < 0) global_max <-  1

span        <- global_max - global_min
if (span == 0) span <- 2
pad         <- span * 0.08
global_xlim <- c(global_min - pad, global_max + pad)

cat(paste("Global X-limits:", round(global_xlim[1], 2), "to", round(global_xlim[2], 2), "\n"))
cat("(1st/99th percentile of raw points; extreme outliers clipped from view)\n\n")

# =============================================================================
# 6. PANEL BUILDER  (faceted 3-column layout — robust to varying label widths)
# =============================================================================
build_tissue_panel <- function(tissue_stats, tissue_raw, tissue_label, xlim) {

  n_col  <- 3
  sorted <- tissue_stats %>% arrange(desc(median))   # top-to-bottom by median
  total  <- nrow(sorted)
  per    <- ceiling(total / n_col)                   # rows in the tallest column

  # Assign each disease to a column and a row-within-column. Filling column-wise
  # keeps each column internally sorted by median (col 1 = highest medians).
  sorted <- sorted %>%
    mutate(
      col_idx = ceiling(row_number() / per),
      row_in_col = row_number() - (col_idx - 1) * per
    )

  # A unique y key per (col,row) so facets don't share/҃collide y levels.
  # We order y by row_in_col DESC so the highest-median disease sits at the top.
  sorted <- sorted %>%
    mutate(
      y_key = sprintf("%d_%02d", col_idx, row_in_col),
      # wrapped display label for the axis
      # No wrapping — names render at full length; figure width is set wide
      # enough below to accommodate the longest ones.
      y_lab = as.character(Disease_Name)
    )

  # Named vector mapping the ordered y_key -> display label
  y_levels <- sorted %>% arrange(col_idx, desc(row_in_col)) %>% pull(y_key)
  y_labels <- setNames(
    sorted$y_lab[match(y_levels, sorted$y_key)],
    y_levels
  )

  sorted$y_key <- factor(sorted$y_key, levels = y_levels)

  # Attach the same col/row/y_key mapping to the raw jitter points
  raw_join <- tissue_raw %>%
    inner_join(
      sorted %>% dplyr::select(Disease_Name, col_idx, y_key),
      by = "Disease_Name"
    )

  facet_labels <- setNames(rep("", n_col), as.character(seq_len(n_col)))

  p <- ggplot(sorted, aes(x = median, y = y_key)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_jitter(
      data   = raw_join,
      aes(x = Z_Score_Median, y = y_key),
      height = 0.2, width = 0,
      alpha  = 0.3, color = "grey60", size = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = bar_color), size = 2.6) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = y_labels) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 3)) +
    facet_wrap(~ col_idx, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y",
               labeller = as_labeller(facet_labels)) +
    labs(x = "Median Z-Score", y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey95"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = YLAB_SIZE, lineheight = 0.85),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text         = element_blank(),
      strip.background   = element_blank(),
      panel.spacing.x    = unit(18, "pt")   # room so each column's y-labels clear the neighbor
    )

  # wrapped-label vertical padding estimate (0 when wrapping is off)
  wrap_pad <- mean(str_count(sorted$y_lab, "\n"))

  # Panel BODY height is (nearly) proportional to the number of rows so that a
  # single disease occupies the same physical height in every tissue. A small
  # fixed term (AXIS_OVERHEAD) covers the x-axis + its title, which each panel
  # needs once regardless of row count; the per-row term does the rest. This is
  # what stops small tissues (few rows) from stretching to match tall ones.
  PER_ROW_H     <- 0.16 * (1 + 0.5 * wrap_pad)   # height per disease row
  AXIS_OVERHEAD <- 0.45                          # once-per-panel axis/title space
  body_height   <- AXIS_OVERHEAD + PER_ROW_H * per

  title_strip <- ggdraw() +
    draw_label(tissue_label, fontface = "bold", size = 11, x = 0.5, hjust = 0.5) +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = NA),
          plot.margin     = margin(4, 0, 4, 0))

  # Title strip is a FIXED height in the same units as body_height, so it doesn't
  # balloon on small panels. Total panel height = title + body, both absolute.
  TITLE_H     <- 0.30
  total_panel <- TITLE_H + body_height

  list(
    plot       = plot_grid(title_strip, p, ncol = 1,
                           rel_heights = c(TITLE_H, body_height)),
    row_height = total_panel
  )
}

# =============================================================================
# 7. BUILD ALL TISSUE PANELS & STACK
# =============================================================================
tissues <- sort(unique(stats_df$Disease_Tissue))
cat(paste("Building panels for", length(tissues), "tissues...\n"))

panel_list    <- list()
panel_heights <- c()

for (tiss in tissues) {
  tiss_stats <- stats_df      %>% filter(Disease_Tissue == tiss)
  tiss_raw   <- plot_data_raw %>% filter(Disease_Tissue == tiss)

  if (nrow(tiss_stats) == 0) next

  cat(paste0("  ", tiss, ": ", nrow(tiss_stats), " diseases\n"))

  result <- build_tissue_panel(tiss_stats, tiss_raw,
                               tissue_label = tiss,
                               xlim         = global_xlim)
  panel_list    <- c(panel_list,    list(result$plot))
  panel_heights <- c(panel_heights, result$row_height)
}

if (length(panel_list) == 0) stop("No panels were built — check Disease_Tissue values.")

final_plot <- plot_grid(
  plotlist    = panel_list,
  ncol        = 1,
  rel_heights = panel_heights,
  align       = "v",
  axis        = "lr"
)

# =============================================================================
# 8. SAVE
# =============================================================================
# panel_heights now already include each panel's title + axis + proportional rows,
# so the figure height is simply their sum (plus a small outer margin). This is
# what makes the whole figure shorter: small tissues contribute little height.
total_height <- sum(panel_heights) + 0.5
outfile <- file.path(output_plot_dir, "Forest_Plot_By_Disease_Tissue.png")

# Labels render at full length (no wrapping), so the figure must be wide enough
# for three columns of long disease names side by side. ~13in covers the longest
# names; increase FIG_WIDTH_IN if any still clip. This is a wide, on-screen
# supplementary figure (exceeds letter paper — tabloid/A3 if printed).
FIG_WIDTH_IN <- 13
ggsave(outfile, final_plot,
       width     = FIG_WIDTH_IN,
       height    = total_height,
       limitsize = FALSE,
       bg        = "white")

cat(paste("\nSaved:", outfile, "\n"))
cat("Done.\n")

# FOREST PLOT: Sema vs SGLT2 OR  +  Sema RGES & SGLT2 RGES (grouped bars)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 1 — FILE PATHS  (edit these before running)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
PATH_OR_SGLT2         = "Disease_Odds_Ratio_Semaglutide_SGLT2_Matched.xlsx"

OUTPUT_DPI            = 300

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SECTION 2 — LOAD DATA - Change depending on your data location
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
or_df     = pd.read_excel('/Users/nabasmita.talukdar/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-TheMountSinaiHospital/GLP/Tables Publication/Disease_Odds_Ratio_Semaglutide_SGLT2_Matched.xlsx')
cdc       = pd.read_excel('/Users/nabasmita.talukdar/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-TheMountSinaiHospital/GLP/EHR_RGES_Disease_Combined_Top_bottom_SGLT2.xlsx')
sema_raw  = pd.read_excel('/Users/nabasmita.talukdar/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-TheMountSinaiHospital/GLP/Semaglutide_Reversal_Scores_2026_postAnnotationsBackup.xlsx')

# SECTION 5 — STOUFFER RGES + BH CORRECTION (SEMA and SGLT2 separately)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def stouffer_stats(grp):
    z = grp['Z_Score_Median'].dropna().values
    n = len(z)
    if n == 0:
        return pd.Series({'median_z': np.nan, 'stouffer_z': np.nan,
                          'p_raw': np.nan, 'n_sigs': 0})
    return pd.Series({
        'median_z':   np.median(z),
        'stouffer_z': z.sum() / np.sqrt(n),
        'p_raw':      2 * stats.norm.sf(abs(z.sum() / np.sqrt(n))),
        'n_sigs':     n
    })

all_originals = plot_df['original'].unique()

# ── Bug 2 fix: process SEMA RGES ─────────────────────────────────────────
sema_stats = sema_raw.groupby('Disease_Name').apply(stouffer_stats).reset_index()
sema_filt  = sema_stats[sema_stats['Disease_Name'].isin(all_originals)].dropna(subset=['p_raw']).copy()
if len(sema_filt) > 0:
    _, padj, _, _ = multipletests(sema_filt['p_raw'], method='fdr_bh')
    sema_filt['p_adj'] = padj

plot_df = plot_df.merge(
    sema_filt[['Disease_Name','median_z','p_adj']].rename(
        columns={'Disease_Name':'original','median_z':'sema_z','p_adj':'sema_p_adj'}),
    on='original', how='left')

# ── Process SGLT2 RGES ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    on='original', how='left')

print(f"SGLT2 RGES matched: {plot_df['sglt2_z'].notna().sum()} / {len(plot_df)}")

load_drug_ranked <- function(drug_sig_name) {
  df <- read_csv(file.path(drug_base, drug_sig_name), show_col_types = FALSE)
  df <- df[!is.na(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk) & !is.na(df$Human_Symbol), ]
  df <- df[!duplicated(df$Human_Symbol), ]
  df <- df[order(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk, decreasing = TRUE), ]
  setNames(df$log2FoldChange_shrunk, df$Human_Symbol)
}

load_disease_query <- function(disease_sig_name) {
  folder <- get_disease_folder(disease_sig_name)
  path   <- file.path(disease_base, folder, disease_sig_name)
  df     <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df     <- df[!is.na(df$padj) & !is.na(df$log2FoldChange) &
               !is.na(df$identifier) & df$padj < 0.05, ]
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(list(up = character(0), down = character(0)))
  symbols   <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = df$identifier,
                      column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                      multiVals = "first")
  df$symbol <- symbols[df$identifier]
  df        <- df[!is.na(df$symbol), ]
  list(
    up   = df$symbol[df$log2FoldChange > 0],
    down = df$symbol[df$log2FoldChange < 0]
  )
}

compute_running_es <- function(gene_set, ranked_stats) {
  n             <- length(ranked_stats)
  gene_pos      <- which(names(ranked_stats) %in% gene_set)
  if (length(gene_pos) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, n))
  hit            <- rep(0, n)
  hit[gene_pos]  <- 1
  stat_abs       <- abs(ranked_stats)
  hit_score      <- stat_abs * hit
  if (sum(hit_score) == 0) return(rep(0, n))
  cumsum(hit_score) / sum(hit_score) - cumsum(1 - hit) / sum(1 - hit)
}

make_fgsea_panel <- function(disease_name, z_score, query, ranked) {
  n      <- length(ranked)
  es_up  <- compute_running_es(query$up,   ranked)
  es_dn  <- compute_running_es(query$down, ranked)

  set.seed(42)
  res_up <- if (length(query$up) > 0)
    fgsea(list(UP   = query$up),   ranked, minSize = 1,
          maxSize = 5000, nPermSimple = 10000) else NULL
  set.seed(42)
  res_dn <- if (length(query$down) > 0)
    fgsea(list(DOWN = query$down), ranked, minSize = 1,
          maxSize = 5000, nPermSimple = 10000) else NULL

  fmt_stat <- function(res) if (!is.null(res))
    sprintf("NES=%.2f p=%s", round(res$NES[1], 2), signif(res$pval[1], 2)) else "n/a"

  df <- data.frame(x = seq_len(n))
  if (!all(is.na(es_up))) df$es_up <- es_up
  if (!all(is.na(es_dn))) df$es_dn <- es_dn

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60",
               linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dashed")

  if ("es_up" %in% names(df))
    p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = es_up, colour = "Disease UP"),
                       linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9)
  if ("es_dn" %in% names(df))
    p <- p + geom_line(aes(y = es_dn, colour = "Disease DOWN"),
                       linewidth = 0.7, alpha = 0.9)

  p +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("Disease UP" = "#D6604D", "Disease DOWN" = "#2166AC"),
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = gsub("-", " ", disease_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("UP: %s    DOWN: %s    Z = %.2f",
                         fmt_stat(res_up), fmt_stat(res_dn), z_score),
      x        = "Drug gene rank (high \u2192 low log\u2082FC)",
      y        = "Enrichment Score"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey35"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 6.5),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fgsea_plots <- list()

for (disease in diseases_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[fgsea] Processing: %s\n", disease))

  override  <- pair_overrides[[disease]]
  pool      <- results_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(Disease_Name == disease)

  best_pair <- if (is.null(override)) {
    pool %>% dplyr::arrange(Z_Score_Median) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
  } else {
    pool %>% dplyr::filter(grepl(override, Drug_Signature, fixed = TRUE)) %>%
             dplyr::arrange(Z_Score_Median) %>% dplyr::slice(1)
  }

  if (nrow(best_pair) == 0) { cat("  No pair found — skipping\n"); next }
  cat(sprintf("  Pair: %s  |  Z = %.4f\n",
              best_pair$Drug_Signature, best_pair$Z_Score_Median))

  ranked <- load_drug_ranked(best_pair$Drug_Signature)
  query  <- load_disease_query(best_pair$Disease_Signature)
  cat(sprintf("  Query genes — UP: %d  DOWN: %d\n",
              length(query$up), length(query$down)))

  if (length(query$up) == 0 && length(query$down) == 0) {
    cat("  No DE genes — skipping\n"); next
  }

  fgsea_plots[[disease]] <- make_fgsea_panel(
    disease_name = disease,
    z_score      = best_pair$Z_Score_Median,
    query        = query,
    ranked       = ranked
  )
  cat("  Done.\n")
}

# ── 2a. Paths ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

results_csv_path      <- "/Users/palmerzs/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-MichiganStateUniversity/ChenLab/semaglutide_project/Full_Survey_Semaglutide/SecondaryDatasetReversalValidation/Reversal_Results/SecondaryDataset_Reversal_Scores.csv"

# ── 2b0. Disease-name harmonization ───────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Different upstream files disagree on disease spellings in two ways:
#   1. Case only:        "Glomerulonephritis-membranous" vs "...-Membranous"
#   2. Genuine word swap: "Glomerulonephritis-Focal-Segmental" vs
#                         "Glomerulosclerosis-Focal-Segmental"
#
# fix_aliases() resolves the word swap by mapping onto the canonical spelling
# used in diseases_of_interest (from Block 1). canon() then collapses pure
# case/separator differences so matching never depends on exact casing.
# NOTE: confirm the FSGS alias really is a typo for the same entity, not two
# distinct conditions, before trusting the merged panel.

fix_aliases <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("Glomerulonephritis-Focal-Segmental",
            "Glomerulosclerosis-Focal-Segmental", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
  x
}

canon <- function(x) tolower(gsub("[-_ ]+", "", x))

# ── 2b. Load & filter to diseases of interest ─────────────────────────────────

# ── 2c. Stouffer stats + BH correction ───────────────────────────────────────

get_stouffer_stats <- function(x) {
  x          <- x[!is.na(x)]
  n          <- length(x)
  median_z   <- median(x)
  stouffer_z <- sum(x) / sqrt(n)
  p_val_raw  <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(stouffer_z))
  c(median = median_z, n = n, stouffer_z = stouffer_z, p_val_raw = p_val_raw)
}

stats_df <- plot_data_raw %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Disease_Name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(stats = list(get_stouffer_stats(Z_Score_Median)),
                   .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)

n_our_diseases <- nrow(stats_df)
n_padding      <- max(0, n_original_diseases - n_our_diseases)
cat(sprintf("Our diseases: %d  |  BH padding: %d dummy p=1 values\n",
            n_our_diseases, n_padding))

padded_pvals       <- c(stats_df$p_val_raw, rep(1.0, n_padding))
adjusted_all       <- p.adjust(padded_pvals, method = "BH")
stats_df$p_val_adj <- adjusted_all[seq_len(n_our_diseases)]

stats_df <- stats_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sig = dplyr::case_when(
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median > 0 ~  1,
      p_val_adj < 0.05 & median < 0 ~ -1,
      TRUE                          ~  0
    ),
    dot_color = dplyr::case_when(
      sig ==  1 ~ "#C0392B",
      sig == -1 ~ "#2E86C1",
      TRUE      ~ "grey70"
    )
  )

cat("\nSummary stats:\n")
print(stats_df %>%
        dplyr::select(Disease_Name, n, median, stouffer_z, p_val_raw, p_val_adj, sig))

# ── 2d. Shared x limits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

jitter_colors <- c(
  "DzSigDatabase"      = "#E67E22",
  "Third Party Dataset" = "#8E44AD"
)

x_min <- min(c(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, stats_df$median), na.rm = TRUE)
x_max <- max(c(plot_data_raw$Z_Score_Median, stats_df$median), na.rm = TRUE)
if (x_min > 0) x_min <- -1
if (x_max < 0) x_max <-  1
span  <- x_max - x_min
if (span == 0) span <- 2
xlim  <- c(x_min - span * 0.05, x_max + span * 0.20)
cat(sprintf("Shared X limits: %.2f to %.2f\n", xlim[1], xlim[2]))

# ── 2e. Panel builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
# Matches on canonical name so the panel builds regardless of the casing/
# separator variant stored in the file. Returns a "no data" placeholder if the
# disease produced no rows, keeping the Block 4 grid intact.

make_reversal_panel <- function(disease) {

  dz_stats <- stats_df      %>% dplyr::filter(canon(Disease_Name) == canon(disease))
  dz_raw   <- plot_data_raw %>% dplyr::filter(canon(Disease_Name) == canon(disease))

  if (nrow(dz_stats) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("  [reversal] no data for %s — placeholder panel\n", disease))
    return(
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0,
                 label = "no data", size = 3, colour = "grey50") +
        theme_void() +
        theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
    )
  }

  wrapped_label    <- stringr::str_wrap(gsub("-", " ", disease), width = 20)
  dz_stats$y_label <- wrapped_label
  dz_raw$y_label   <- wrapped_label

  ggplot(dz_stats, aes(x = median, y = y_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(
      data   = dz_raw,
      aes(x = Z_Score_Median, y = y_label, fill = sig_type),
      shape  = 21, color = "white", stroke = 0.2,
      height = 0.25, width = 0,
      alpha  = 0.80, size  = 2.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = jitter_colors,
      name   = "Signature Type",
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1))
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = dot_color), size = 5) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x     = xlim[2] * 0.90,
      y     = 1,
      hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.5, color = "grey30",
      label = paste0("p.adj=", signif(dz_stats$p_val_adj, 2),
                     "  n=", dz_stats$n)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      trans  = scales::pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 0.5, base = 10),
      breaks = c(-10, -5, -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 5, 10)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim) +
    labs(
      title = gsub("-", " ", disease),
      x     = "Median Z-Score",
      y     = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey93"),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7, lineheight = 0.8),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 6.5),
      legend.position    = "none",     # collected at assembly in Block 4
      plot.margin        = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── 3a. Paths & settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# ── 3e. Panel builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

make_network_panel <- function(disease_name, drug_sig,
                               drug_set, dis_set,
                               proximity_score, z_score_prox,
                               median_prox_disease, z_score_median_prox) {

  nodes    <- igraph::V(string_graph)$name
  drug_vis <- head(unique(intersect(drug_set, nodes)), n_vis)
  dis_vis  <- head(unique(intersect(dis_set,  nodes)), n_vis)

  if (length(drug_vis) == 0 || length(dis_vis) == 0) {
    cat("  Empty gene set after intersection — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  dist_mat    <- igraph::distances(string_graph, v = drug_vis, to = dis_vis)
  close_pairs <- which(dist_mat <= max_path, arr.ind = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("  Close pairs (dist <= %d): %d\n", max_path, nrow(close_pairs)))

  if (nrow(close_pairs) == 0) {
    cat("  No close pairs — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  path_nodes <- c()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(close_pairs))) {
    p <- tryCatch(
      igraph::shortest_paths(
        string_graph,
        from   = drug_vis[close_pairs[k, 1]],
        to     = dis_vis [close_pairs[k, 2]],
        output = "vpath"
      )$vpath[[1]],
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (!is.null(p) && length(p) > 0)
      path_nodes <- c(path_nodes, as.integer(p))
  }

  path_nodes <- unique(path_nodes[!is.na(path_nodes)])
  if (length(path_nodes) < 2) {
    cat("  Insufficient path nodes — skipping\n"); return(NULL)
  }

  subg <- igraph::induced_subgraph(string_graph, path_nodes)
  igraph::V(subg)$role <- "intermediate"
  igraph::V(subg)$role[igraph::V(subg)$name %in% drug_vis] <- "drug"
  igraph::V(subg)$role[igraph::V(subg)$name %in% dis_vis]  <- "disease"
  igraph::V(subg)$display_label <- ifelse(
    igraph::V(subg)$role != "intermediate",
    string_to_symbol_map[igraph::V(subg)$name],
    ""
  )
  cat(sprintf("  Subgraph: %d nodes, %d edges\n",
              igraph::vcount(subg), igraph::ecount(subg)))

  z_sign        <- ifelse(z_score_prox >= 0, "+", "")
  z_sign_median <- ifelse(z_score_median_prox >= 0, "+", "")
  z_label <- sprintf(
    "Proximity (this pair) = %.3f  (%s%.2f SD)\nMedian proximity (all pairs) = %.3f  (%s%.2f SD)",
    proximity_score,     z_sign,        z_score_prox,
    median_prox_disease, z_sign_median, z_score_median_prox
  )
  z_color <- ifelse(z_score_prox <= 0, "#2166AC", "#D6604D")

  set.seed(42)   # FR layout is stochastic — fix for reproducibility
  ggraph(subg, layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(colour = "grey75", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.4) +
    geom_node_point(aes(colour = role, shape = role, size = role)) +
    geom_node_text(
      aes(label = display_label),
      repel        = TRUE,
      size         = 2.2,          # scaled for ~2.5" panel width
      max.overlaps = 30,
      fontface     = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c(drug         = "#2166AC",
                 disease      = "#D6604D",
                 intermediate = "grey55"),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c(drug = 17, disease = 19, intermediate = 19),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    scale_size_manual(
      values = c(drug = 3, disease = 3, intermediate = 1.4),
      labels = c("Semaglutide-perturbed genes", "Disease genes", "Intermediate")
    ) +
    labs(
      title    = gsub("-", " ", disease_name),
      subtitle = sprintf("Drug: %s  |  Nodes: %d  Edges: %d",
                         gsub("_DESeq2_results.csv", "", drug_sig),
                         igraph::vcount(subg), igraph::ecount(subg)),
      caption  = z_label,
      colour   = NULL, shape = NULL, size = NULL
    ) +
    theme_graph(base_family = "sans") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",       # collected at assembly in Block 4
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 6.5, colour = "grey40"),
      plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold",
                                     colour = z_color, hjust = 0.5,
                                     margin = margin(t = 4)),
      plot.margin     = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
    )
}

# ── 3f. Main loop ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

network_plots <- list()

for (disease in diseases_of_interest) {
  cat(sprintf("\n[network] Processing: %s\n", disease))

  best_pair <- prox_filtered %>%
    dplyr::filter(canon(Disease_Name) == canon(disease), !is.na(Proximity_N10)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Proximity_N10) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(best_pair) == 0) { cat("  No pair found — skipping\n"); next }

  prox_score   <- best_pair$Proximity_N10[1]
  z_score_prox <- (prox_score - global_mean) / global_sd
  median_prox_disease <- median(
    prox_filtered %>% dplyr::filter(canon(Disease_Name) == canon(disease)) %>% dplyr::pull(Proximity_N10),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  z_score_median_prox <- (median_prox_disease - global_mean) / global_sd
  drug_set     <- drug_gene_sets_de[[best_pair$Drug_Signature]]$N10
  dis_set      <- disease_gene_sets_de[[best_pair$Disease_Signature]]$N10

  cat(sprintf("  Pair: %s\n", best_pair$Drug_Signature))
  cat(sprintf("  Proximity_N10 = %.4f  |  Z = %.2f SD\n",
              prox_score, z_score_prox))
  cat(sprintf("  Drug genes: %d  |  Disease genes: %d\n",
              length(drug_set), length(dis_set)))

  if (length(drug_set) == 0 || length(dis_set) == 0) {
    cat("  Empty gene set — skipping\n"); next
  }

  # Store under the canonical name so 3g lookups always match
  network_plots[[disease]] <- make_network_panel(
    disease_name        = disease,
    drug_sig            = best_pair$Drug_Signature,
    drug_set            = drug_set,
    dis_set             = dis_set,
    proximity_score     = prox_score,
    z_score_prox        = z_score_prox,
    median_prox_disease = median_prox_disease,
    z_score_median_prox = z_score_median_prox
  )
  cat("  Done.\n")
}

# ── 3g. Named exports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

no_data_panel <- function() {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0,
             label = "no data", size = 3, colour = "grey50") +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
}

or_blank <- function(p) if (is.null(p)) no_data_panel() else p

p_net_1 <- or_blank(network_plots[["Bronchiolitis-Obliterans-Syndrome"]])
p_net_2 <- or_blank(network_plots[["Glomerulonephritis-Membranous"]])
p_net_3 <- or_blank(network_plots[["Glomerulosclerosis-Focal-Segmental"]])

# ── 3h. Preview ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

print(p_net_1)
print(p_net_2)
print(p_net_3)

preview_net <- (p_net_1 / p_net_2 / p_net_3) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Block 3 preview — network panels")

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "PREVIEW_block3_network.png"),
  plot     = preview_net,
  width    = 3.5, height = 9, dpi = 150, bg = "white"
)
cat("\nBlock 3 preview saved to:", file.path(out_dir, "PREVIEW_block3_network.png"), "\n")













# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# BLOCK 4: Assembly & export
# Inputs:  p_fgsea_1/2/3 · p_rev_1/2/3 · p_net_1/2/3
# Outputs: FigureFinal.pdf + FigureFinal.png in out_dir
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(patchwork)

# ── 4a. Assemble 3×3 grid ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#
#   Col 1: fgsea enrichment     Col 2: reversal forest     Col 3: network proximity
#   ┌─────────────┬─────────────┬─────────────┐
#   │  p_fgsea_1  │   p_rev_1   │   p_net_1   │  Row 1: ARVD
#   ├─────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┤
#   │  p_fgsea_2  │   p_rev_2   │   p_net_2   │  Row 2: Myotonic Dystrophy
#   ├─────────────┼─────────────┼─────────────┤
#   │  p_fgsea_3  │   p_rev_3   │   p_net_3   │  Row 3: Huntington Disease
#   └─────────────┴─────────────┴─────────────┘

figure_final <-
  (p_fgsea_1 | p_rev_1 | p_net_1) /
  (p_fgsea_2 | p_rev_2 | p_net_2) /
  (p_fgsea_3 | p_rev_3 | p_net_3)

# ── 4b. Layout: equal panels, collected legends at bottom ─────────────────────

figure_final <- figure_final +
  plot_layout(
    widths  = c(1, 1, 1),
    heights = c(1, 1, 1),
    guides  = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# ── 4c. Annotation: panel tags + figure title ─────────────────────────────────

figure_final <- figure_final +
  plot_annotation(
    tag_levels = NULL,
    title      = "",
    theme      = theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.tag      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9)
    )
  )

# ── 4d. Preview in RStudio viewer ────────────────────────────────────────────

#print(figure_final)

# ── 4e. Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fig_width  <- 10     # inches — adjust if panels feel cramped
fig_height <- 10     # inches — equal gives square panels

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "FigureFinal_supp.pdf"),
  plot     = figure_final,
  width    = fig_width,
  height   = fig_height,
  device   = "pdf"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "FigureFinal_supp.png"),
  plot     = figure_final,
  width    = fig_width,
  height   = fig_height,
  dpi      = 300,
  bg       = "white"
)

cat("\nFigure saved to:", out_dir, "\n")
